item.title: When High Capacity Becomes Undeployable: Pore-Filling Constraints for Multi-Objective Optimization of Direct Air Capture Sorbents
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-25　分类：论文PDF

Amine-impregnated sorbents with the highest nominal CO2 capacity are frequently …

Amine-impregnated sorbents with the highest nominal CO2 capacity are frequently the least deployable, as amine beyond the pore-volume limit blocks active sites. Yet multi-objective Bayesian optimization (MOBO) for direct air capture (DAC) treats formulation search as unconstrained. We encode the pore-filling boundary as an explicit outcome constraint, c(x) = tanh(1 - phi_hat) - tau, and use it as a diagnostic instrument on a hand-curated, DOI-traceable benchmark of 618 solid-amine formulations from 43 publications. Unconstrained MOBO attains higher nominal capacity (3.639 +/- 0.815 vs. 2.964 +/- 0.728 mmol/g, p = 1.0e-11), but across 100 seeds 63.2% of its Pareto-optimal candidates violate the pore-filling boundary versus 39.3% under the constraint: it is rewarded for proposing candidates outside the pore-confined design regime. The constraint steers the front to lower loadings (55.8 vs. 65.2 wt%) and larger pores. The boundary is corroborated once apparatus effects are harmonized hierarchically: 77.8% of kinetic variance is between-laboratory, and pore filling carries a significant kinetic penalty (p = 0.002). Standard hypervolume over-credits feasibility-agnostic methods by 13.9-…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Understanding Mode Collapse in Diffusion Models under Classifier-Free Guidance
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-25　分类：论文PDF

The use of classifier-free guidance in diffusion and flow models has proven crit…

The use of classifier-free guidance in diffusion and flow models has proven critical to their empirical success, as it allows for the controllable generation of lower-temperature and higher-fidelity samples. Despite its widespread use, classifier-free guidance remains both empirically and theoretically poorly understood, owing to the difficulty of solving the associated transport equations for arbitrary normalizing flows. In this paper, we observe that the effects of classifier-free guidance arise from a mismatch between the representation capabilities of the conditional and unconditional distributions, wherein the conditional distribution exhibits higher complexity and fidelity. We propose an analytical model to capture this observation: the conditional distribution is a Gaussian mixture whose means lie on an ellipsoid, and the unconditional distribution is a single Gaussian approximating the mixture. The flows arising from this mixture are closed under scaling, enabling us to derive analytic closed-form solutions for the guided distribution at all noise scales and guidance levels. Our analytic solution shows that classifier-free guidance induces (a) a shift along a mean-axis dire…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Text-Conditioned Low-Rank Adaptation of Time-Series Foundation Models for Multimodal Forecasting
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-25　分类：论文PDF

Time-series foundation models (TSFMs) provide transferable numerical forecasting…

Time-series foundation models (TSFMs) provide transferable numerical forecasting priors. However, forecast-relevant information may be conveyed in text without being reflected in the observed series. Many multimodal forecasting methods integrate such context through model inputs or intermediate representations. We investigate a complementary mechanism: text-conditioned parameter adaptation. We propose Context-to-LoRA for Time Series (C2LoRA-TS), which encodes text and generates temporary Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) updates for selected weight matrices of a frozen TSFM. Both the numerical backbone and text encoder remain frozen, and the method exactly recovers the frozen TSFM output when context is absent. Evaluated on Time-MMD across nine domains and three TSFM architectures, C2LoRA-TS achieves lower aggregate forecasting error than the frozen-TSFM and Static LoRA baselines for every architecture and seed. Replacing the instance-specific text with a single globally fixed context degrades performance for every architecture. These results support text-conditioned parameter generation as a viable strategy for multimodal forecasting with frozen TSFMs.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: SysBio-SR: Benchmarking Symbolic Regression for Trajectory Fidelity and Mechanism Recovery in Systems Biology
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-25　分类：论文PDF

Symbolic regression seeks to discover interpretable governing equations for dyna…

Symbolic regression seeks to discover interpretable governing equations for dynamical systems from data. In systems biology, however, accurately reproducing system trajectories does not necessarily imply recovery of the underlying reaction mechanisms. Existing benchmarks evaluate numerical accuracy, expression complexity, or equation-level similarity, but not agreement between recovered reactions and reference mechanisms in biological systems. We introduce SysBio-SR, a benchmark of 198 literature-based biological ODE systems with reaction annotations spanning mass action, Michaelis--Menten, Hill, and complex kinetics. Trajectory fidelity is evaluated across all systems under in-distribution reconstruction and out-of-distribution (OOD) extrapolation, while mechanism recovery is assessed on the subset of 161 systems. We evaluate trajectory fidelity across 11 symbolic-discovery methods and assess mechanism recovery for three reaction-based methods. Joint analysis across systems highlights how severely trajectory-based evaluation overestimates true mechanism recovery. Motivated by these findings, we develop KineSelect, a framework that searches candidate reaction topologies under biolo…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Strong Starts, Simple Recipes: Unified Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation from Multimodal Specialists
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-25　分类：论文PDF

Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) integrates separately trained domain…

Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) integrates separately trained domain specialists into a single unified model. Existing methods focus on refining the distillation procedure while initializing the student from a base model or a multi-domain SFT checkpoint, which leaves capability integration largely to distillation itself. Instead, we treat the starting point as a design variable and propose Unified MOPD (Uni-MOPD), which pairs a strong start with a simple recipe: a training-free uniform merge of specialists from the same base model initializes the student, and short MOPD with uniform domain sampling and full-vocabulary reverse KL refines it. Across five multimodal domains and 19 benchmarks, our study establishes three findings. (1) The starting point matters more than subsequent training choices: before any training, the uniform merge already matches the score that the base model reaches after 200 MOPD updates, and after short distillation it matches higher-scoring, search-based starts. (2) Short MOPD recovers most of the capabilities the merge leaves unintegrated; it improves every domain, with the largest gains where the domain teacher still leads. (3) From a strong st…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: State Space Attention: Learning Context-Dependent Memory Retention
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-25　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 标准注意力 KV 缓存随上下文线性增长；限制缓存后，长上下文序列模型应保留什么？作者主张这一选择应被学习出来。

方法 提出 State Space Attention：学习保留一组有界历史表示，用标准注意力读取；学习评分器针对新上下文与其余记忆对每个 chunk 重新评分。固定上下文 Transformer 只是"总保留最近 token"的特例；训练中用 recovery 生成监督样本，可软硬过渡或直接硬保留。

关键数字 检索与推理基准上多数任务匹配或接近全注意力几个点内，大幅超越相同可读预算的 Transformer，匹敌约 4 倍预算者且推理内存恒定；最大差距在 RULER；400M 模型上测了训练/推理成本随上下文与尺寸的缩放。

为什么值得看 可学习记忆保留 + 标准注意力读取，可与 KV 驱逐方法堆叠，长上下文恒定内存方案。

item.title: Spec2Weights: Certifying Networks that a Language Model Writes from a Specification
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-25　分类：论文PDF

A language model can write the weights of a small MLP, CNN, RNN or GNN from a pl…

A language model can write the weights of a small MLP, CNN, RNN or GNN from a plain-language specification, with no data and no gradient step. We ask when such a network can be proved exact in the float32 arithmetic it actually runs in. A float-safety lemma makes exhaustive float32 enumeration a proof for any summation order, and a layered error bound covers networks whose weights are not short binary fractions. With dynamic programming, template checks, an SMT proof, breadth-first search and induction for weight-tied recurrences, this certifies 12 of 15 written networks (one after a single constant fix) on every input of a stated domain (up to $10^{16}$ inputs, or every graph or grid up to a size bound), in a minute of CPU or less each. The certificates also say where a network stops being exact: the shortest-path network is exact iff the distance is at most 4,096 and fails at the predicted hops. Thirty new specifications were each written by a fresh session of one model family (Claude Opus 5.5). Twenty-five first submissions are certified exact for any summation order; the five tax schedules stay within \$0.11 of the true tax at every whole dollar in one fixed float32 run. An ope…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: SentryWard: Formal Verification of Warp-Specialized GPU Kernels
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.PL)　发布：2026-11-25　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 warp 特化 GPU kernel 重叠异步搬运与异构计算，引入复杂同步需求；顺序错误导致数据竞争与错误结果，且不确定、仅稀有调度出现，测试无法保证正确性。

方法 提出 SentryWard：整合同步验证、数据竞争与资源生命周期分析、功能等价检查。核心是证明同步在所有执行调度上诱导相同排序约束——把良好同步分析扩展到带异步事务跟踪的现代 GPU barrier，导出调度无关 happens-before 图，验证内存安全并构造符号输出表达式。

关键数字 摘要未给量化指标；用线程与张量计算的紧凑表示提升可扩展性，代码已在 GitHub 开源。

为什么值得看 首个面向 warp 特化 GPU kernel 的形式化验证框架，直击异步重叠优化的正确性盲区。

item.title: Scaling Looped MoE Language Models under Matched Budgets: Information Flow and Parameter Allocation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-25　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 循环 Transformer 解耦计算深度与参数量，但等参数（iso-parameter）与等 FLOP 约束下的系统化配置原则仍然稀缺。

方法 用门控内循环状态更新与跨阶段残差改进信息流；受控研究识别出"单遍 Core 深度占展开总深度 25%–35% + 省下参数重分配给每层额外 routed experts"的配置，零额外计算提升性能。

关键数字 1T 预训练 tokens 后，69B MLA 与 51B KDA MoE 在四基准平均超越预算匹配的非循环基线 1.16 与 2.29 个百分点；200B token 复现实验困惑度低于其他循环方法。

为什么值得看 等预算约束下循环 MoE 的实用设计原则与参数分配依据，代码已开源。

item.title: Same Seed, Different Top Prediction: Cross-Platform Reproducibility of AlphaFold 3 Inference on TPUs, GPUs, and CPUs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.DC)　发布：2026-11-25　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 AlphaFold 3 返回多次采样中排名最高的结构并在单一设备计算；设备间浮点结果可能不同，相同输入与种子可能返回不同结构，文档与输出均无警告。

方法 在 TPU（v5e、v6e）、GPU（L4、A100、H100）与 Intel Xeon CPU 上用相同输入、权重、种子测量设备改变返回结构的频率。

关键数字 60 个蛋白-配体复合物、每 5 种子：切换 TPU 代际使 300 次预测中 18.0% 的最高排名样本改变；L4 重编译改变 7.3%；顶部姿态正确↔错误切换占 3.3%–3.7%（新种子约 10%）；float32 trunk + 全精度矩阵乘积使五设备几乎全一致。

为什么值得看 系统量化 AlphaFold3 的设备相关不确定性，建议报告设备与每个近似并列样本。

item.title: Routeability Before Routing: Routeability Audit Protocol (RAP) and RouteabilityBench for Audited LLM Model Selection
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-25　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 LLM 路由只有在基准含足够 prompt 级差异、不同模型各擅胜场时才有意义；粗评分基准上模型常并列最佳，单一最佳模型已留不下多少提升空间。

item.title: Reading Fine-Tuning Diffs Through Lenses: Model Diffing for Backdoor Detection
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-25　分类：论文PDF

We introduce a common scoring system based on token readouts to evaluate weight,…

We introduce a common scoring system based on token readouts to evaluate weight, activation and output-based model diffing methods for backdoor detection in fine-tuning processes. We also improve existing weight and activation based methods by incorporating the $J$-lens and its refinement, the $J{+}{+}$-lens. We test our setup in experiments where we compare a backdoored model with the base model from which it was fine-tuned. Our results show that incorporating the $J{+}{+}$-lens improves the weight-based method in all our settings, while the $J$-lens improves its ranks within single layers. The strongest single method is $ΔW J{+}{+}$, the weight difference decoded through the $J{+}{+}$-lens of the base model, which ranks a token naming the backdoor among its first ten tokens in 11 of our 12 settings. Moreover, we show that output and activation based methods such as ADL and Diff Mining can easily break if the backdoored model is penalised during fine-tuning for giving the backdoor's words probability on clean inputs, whereas the weight-based methods are not affected. Conversely, permuting the hidden units or training only the layers that read the residual stream hides the backdoor…

item.title: Quaternion-Tucker ZigZag Networks: Halving Transformer Backbone Parameters and Enabling Exact 2D Zero-Loss Continual Scaling
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-25　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题 标准 Transformer 的 FFN 每层独立稠密权重，参数量随深度线性增长；权重共享的循环 Transformer 解耦深度与参数，却强制时间均匀更新。

方法 将 L 层 FFN 建模为 3D 张量立方体，提出 QuatTucker-ZigZagGPT：4D 四元数 Hamilton GEMM（4x FFN 压缩）、64x64 块对角 Tucker SwiGLU 核、辫状 ZigZag 菱形路由（零 FLOP 精化）与宽度/深度双维零损失持续缩放；GatedBounce 自蒸馏推理开销 0.0%。

关键数字 A100 上 39.0M 骨干的 Q12 在 5/5 检查点胜过 85.0M 的 StandardGPT-12；持续缩放 6.00B tokens（宽度 6144→8192、深度 12→16→20，max_diff=0）后 FineWeb-Edu loss 3.3582，16,955 题零样本准确率 44.75%，以 50x 更少 tokens 匹敌 GPT-3 Small。

为什么值得看 参数减半 + 无损持续缩放的完整方案，对高效骨干与模型缩放有直接参考价值。

item.title: Provably Efficient Offline Discounted Reinforcement Learning under Recursive Entropic Risk
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-25　分类：论文PDF

We study risk-sensitive reinforcement learning in finite discounted infinite-hor…

We study risk-sensitive reinforcement learning in finite discounted infinite-horizon Markov Decision Processes with recursive entropic risk measures (ERM), parameterized by $β\neq 0$. We consider both risk-averse ($β>0$) and risk-seeking ($β<0$) settings. We consider the offline RL setting, where the agent is provided with a fixed dataset and wishes to learn a near-optimal policy using this dataset. We introduce a model-based algorithm, called ERM Value Iteration Lower Confidence Bound (ERM-VI-LCB) and derive a PAC-type bound on its sample complexity. We also establish a corresponding lower bound, demonstrating that exponential dependence on $|β|/(1-γ)$ asserted by the upper bound is unavoidable in the worst case. The presented bounds provide the first rigorous sample complexity guarantees for offline RL under recursive ERM across both risk-averse and risk-seeking regimes.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-25　分类：论文PDF

Concave utility reinforcement learning (CURL) unifies a diverse range of problem…

Concave utility reinforcement learning (CURL) unifies a diverse range of problems, including standard reinforcement learning (RL), imitation learning, and maximum entropy exploration. Unlike standard RL, CURL generally requires estimating high-dimensional state-action occupancy measures. Consequently, existing methods for CURL either sidestep the exploration problem, are restricted to the tabular setting, or lack computationally efficient policy optimization. To address this, we study CURL in finite-horizon episodic bilinear MDPs, where the transition model admits a low-dimensional representation in known feature spaces. We use the bilinear structure to efficiently estimate occupancy measures via low-dimensional feature expectations, and propose a model-based optimistic concave utility policy optimization (OCUPO) framework. We first instantiate OCUPO in the on-policy setting, where each iteration uses independent trajectories to estimate the concave utility policy gradient, and prove an $\widetilde{O}(ε^{-4})$ sample complexity. To improve sample efficiency, we then instantiate OCUPO in the off-policy setting. We propose a novel backward feature regression subroutine that reuses tr…

item.title: Privileged On-Policy Distillation for Calibrated Alzheimer's Diagnosis With Missing Modalities
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-25　分类：论文PDF

Alzheimer's disease is diagnosed from clinical, biospecimen and imaging evidence…

Alzheimer's disease is diagnosed from clinical, biospecimen and imaging evidence, but few patients undergo every test. Because these modalities are complementary, a missing one has many plausible values. Most existing methods leave it out or train on one estimate, so their classifier never sees its other values, and the estimate is never checked against the diagnosis. We address both gaps with on-policy distillation: the model fills in the missing modalities itself, and teachers with information available only in training grade these fills. Our method, Graded Rollout Imputation with Privileged teachers, draws several fills, one modality at a time. An imputation teacher that knows the diagnosis grades each step, bringing the outcome into the imputation as statistical practice recommends. A diagnosis teacher that sees all real modalities supplies a soft target. Trained on fills that vary, the model learns a confidence that reflects what the missing tests leave open, and it diagnoses from a single rollout. On the Alzheimer's Disease Neuroimaging Initiative cohort, it outperforms state-of-the-art baselines. On two external cohorts, it remains competitive in discrimination and, even aft…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Pretraining for Forecasting in Relational Databases
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-25　分类：论文PDF

Real-world forecasting increasingly relies on asynchronous transaction logs in r…

Real-world forecasting increasingly relies on asynchronous transaction logs in relational databases rather than uniformly sampled arrays. While relational deep learning (RDL) models can forecast from these complex histories, they are typically trained separately for each specific target and root entity type. We introduce Query-Conditioned Relational pretraining (QCRP), a self-supervised framework that enables a standard RDL backbone to act as a universal forecaster across a database. QCRP generates diverse forecasting objectives using a structured temporal query grammar and interleaves them through a shared conditional predictor. This produces a robust, frozen encoder reusable for downstream tasks via lightweight predictors or a zero-shot interface. Evaluated on large-scale RelBench databases, QCRP learns frozen representations that support competitive forecasting across tasks and entity types. Furthermore, a single unified QCRP model checkpoint is competitive with isolated, entity-specific specialists. We demonstrate promising results for reusing the learned representations from standard RDL backbones for forecasting tasks in relational databases.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: PipeAxes: Decoupling Compute and Communication Granularities for Pipeline-Parallel LLM Serving
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.DC)　发布：2026-11-25　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题： 流水线并行服务长上下文模型时，prefill 切块大小陷入两难：小块频繁重载模型权重、大块让 GPU 与链路长时间忙碌而延迟交互请求，如何在异构/PCIe 集群上兼顾？

方法： PipeAxes 运行宽 prefill 批但每次只算几层，decode 在切片间穿插执行；融合 Triton Hadamard-INT4 编解码压缩激活（按独立行组经并行 TCP 套接字传输）；调度器用延迟余量选择批宽、切片深度与行组大小。

关键数字： A800/RTX 4090/3090 上 97 次重放覆盖 5016 请求，10 倍带宽波动下 74 个请求全部达标；四阶段 MoE 流水线中以 23.3x（相对 Revisit-PP）、4.44x（相对 Fixed-4096）速率达标服务；64K 上下文混合负载下短请求 p95 TTFT 从 129.8s 降至 512ms。

为什么值得看： 计算与通信粒度解耦的工程方案，长上下文交互延迟从分钟级压到毫秒级。

item.title: MolGPAO: Molecular Generative Pre-trained Autoregressive Octree with Speculative Decoding and Sub-Millisecond Seam Healing for 3D Molecules
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-25　分类：论文PDF

Autoregressive generation over adaptive 3D octrees (Uni-3DAR) offers an intrinsi…

Autoregressive generation over adaptive 3D octrees (Uni-3DAR) offers an intrinsic $O(N \log N)$ sparsity advantage over dense $O(N^2)$ equivariant diffusion and flow models on large drug-like molecules, yet lags in geometric equilibrium, closed-shell valence stability, and property fidelity due to Morton-seam coordinate jumps, leaf-heavy compute with root-count trapping, and target-shortcut collapse in internal critics. We introduce MolGPAO (Molecular Generative Pre-trained Autoregressive Octree), a standalone 3D octree architecture and single-output speculative tree-decoding engine using zero external surrogates, zero reinforcement learning, and zero inference-time MLIP relaxation. MolGPAO unifies: (1) non-trapping 6-D ScaleFreeBudgetEmbedding with L5-to-L1 covalent packing priors; (2) a FlashAttention-2 pause-and-gather speculative octree funnel ($m_{s1} \to m_{s2} \to 1$, $M_{\mathrm{out}} = 1$); (3) an anti-shortcut ground-truth TwoStageOctreeProcessCritic with 64-RBF covalent edge gating and $SO(3)$-invariant 12-channel multipole norms (blind QM9 $r = 0.9867$--$0.9989$); (4) a $<0.5$ ms 4-layer $SE(3)$ PostTreeGraphRefiner for Morton-seam healing, expected-XYZ bonded supervisi…

item.title: Mixture-of-Loops Transformer
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-25　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题： 循环 Transformer 复用共享层提升表达力但牺牲效率——推进其表达力-效率前沿的关键问题是：相邻循环之间应该传什么？

方法： MoLT 的 Mixture-of-Loops Attention（MoLA）以 KV 作为跨深度与循环选择性复用的记忆；循环残差变体 MoLT-R 保留残差流读取局部 KV，循环 KV 变体 MoLT-KV 从 embedding 重启并组合前/本循环 KV，消除同位置跨循环依赖、支持单遍历解码；U-MoLT 分离记忆构建与预测读出，跳过未用解码器遍历而不改变预测。

关键数字： 400B token 预训练中 U-MoLT 超 OLMo3（700M/1.5B dense、3B MoE）：700M 验证 CE token 效率 1.7x，3B MoE 十域困惑度 -0.75、十任务准确率 +2.1 点；推理延迟 996.6 vs 1000.6 ms（S 规模 ~113M）。

为什么值得看： 重新定义循环间传递内容，解锁超出训练循环视野的单遍历解码，效率与质量双收。

关键数字： 400B token 预训练中 U-MoLT 超 OLMo3（700M/1.5B dense、3B MoE）：700M 验证 CE token 效率 1.7x，3B MoE 十域困惑度 -0.75、十任务准确率 +2.1 点；推理延迟 996.6 vs 1000.6 ms（S 规模 ~113M）。

为什么值得看： 重新定义循环间传递内容，解锁超出训练循环视野的单遍历解码，效率与质量双收。

item.title: MixMoMo: Accelerating Extra--Large MoE Inference with Mixed--Precision GPU--NPU Execution on Mobile Devices
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.AR)　发布：2026-11-25　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题： 移动端运行超大 MoE 模型需混合精度量化，但现有离线指标与路由分数无法反映专家对量化的敏感度，且多样位宽使 GPU/NPU 间专家分配失衡、tile 级反量化未充分利用 NPU 向量并行。

方法： MixMoMo 运行时：离线量化影响画像 + 基于激活的运行时风险估计共同决定质量约束下的专家位宽；精度结构化执行实现 GPU-NPU 均衡分配；HVX 并行反量化提升 NPU 向量利用率。

关键数字： 3 个 MoE 模型 × 5 个 benchmark × 2 个移动平台，平均解码加速 3.72x（相对均匀 Q4_0）、1.53x（相对最强混合精度 MoE 基线）。

为什么值得看： 面向移动异构 SoC 的端侧超大 MoE 落地路线，质量约束下的位宽分配与异构执行均有实测收益。

item.title: LoopTitan: What Does Parameter Revisit Buy a Mixture-of-Experts?
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-25　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题： 循环 MoE 跨深度复访层参数、不加参数而增加有效深度，近期研究声称在匹配预算下收益显著——但这些增益混入了网络形状与残差尺度等设计选择，"参数复访本身"到底买到什么？

方法： 用匹配的非复访对照分解 SOTA 循环配方（复访放最后）：非复访对照保留全部增益——大部分来自网络形状、其余来自残差尺度；证明残差尺度等价于对复访层施加更低学习率（在 AdamW 不均匀层步长下有助益，Muon 下消失）；再在匹配预算外评估"固定参数加算力"。

关键数字： 无复访的更深标准 MoE 在 Muon 下获得复访增益的 90.2%；额外一次复访胜过专家数翻倍；发布 17 个预训练模型（含 LoopTitan-Base 与对照），预测预注册、探索历史公开。

为什么值得看： 严谨的消融把循环 MoE 的增益归因到网络形状/优化器/加算力，并给出更强基线，纠正叙事、防止复现陷阱。

item.title: Libtt: A Compiler and Runtime for Tenstorrent Processors
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.DC)　发布：2026-11-25　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题： 如何把 PyTorch/JAX 生态带到 Tenstorrent 硬件，让现有框架与为 TPU 编写的软件无需大改即可运行？

方法： Libtt 实现 PJRT 接口（XLA 系框架驱动 Google TPU 的接口）：JAX 直接运行、PyTorch 经 TorchTPU 运行、为 TPU 编写的软件除替换自定义 kernel 外零改动；基于 Tenstorrent 开源编译器与运行时，整个栈（编译器到多芯片运行时）打包为单个共享库，并附带大量上游修复与新编译优化。

关键数字： 通过大部分 JAX 与 TorchTPU 测试套件；可运行 SGLang、TorchTitan、Miles，覆盖服务、微调与强化学习场景。

为什么值得看： 以单库交付全栈，TPU 软件资产可近乎无损迁移到 Tenstorrent，是异构硬件生态互通的重要一步。

item.title: Learning to Be Truncated: Preparing LLM Checkpoints for SVD Compression
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-25　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题： SVD 压缩通常需要后续微调或权重修正来缓解性能退化，且不同压缩率需要重复做预算特定的优化——能否一次准备、多比率复用？

方法： LLift 用原模型作教师，在单一比率下微调低秩近似，把学习到的更新合并回原始权重，同时保留训练前向中被排除的互补成分；随后对准备后模型的目标矩阵做 SVD，在不同截断秩上复用分解。

关键数字： LLaMA-7B 上用单个准备模型在三种压缩率下均获得准确率提升；收益跨模型家族、模型规模与 SVD 压缩算子泛化。

为什么值得看： 免去每个压缩预算单独微调，一次准备即可覆盖多种部署预算，压缩流程成本显著降低。

item.title: LLM-coupled interpretable tool wear monitoring with multi-evidence reasoning in CNC machining
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-25　分类：论文PDF

Interpretable tool wear assessment in CNC machining is challenging. Existing dia…

Interpretable tool wear assessment in CNC machining is challenging. Existing diagnostic models have high accuracy but provide limited guidance for tool replacement. This study proposes a two layer framework combining deep learning wear classification and LLM assisted reasoning. The first layer uses PCA Loading feature selection and optimized GRU to recognize three wear states, achieving 98.38 percent macro F1 score on the PHM2010 dataset. The second layer uses LLMs to generate natural language reports and replacement suggestions from classification results and feature trends. Engineer evaluation shows the reports outperform rule templates. Cross dataset tests on NASA milling data support the generalizability of this framework.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: L2C2: Enhancing Large-scale Chiplets for Agent Long-Context LLM Inference with Sparse and Distributed Attention
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.AR)　发布：2026-11-25　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题： 面向 agent 的长上下文推理需求上升，稀疏注意力（SpAt）+ chiplet 是减计算、扩规模的方向，但 SpAt 部署到分布式 chiplet 需要上下文并行做工作负载切分，分布式注意力实现复杂。

方法： L2C2 系统优化：部分预填充阶段提出 Split-Comm Attention（利用 chiplet 高带宽互联以通信换内存访问）并与传统 Ring Attention 组合成 Bi-Mode 适应不同序列长度；解码阶段分析内存访问失衡根因，用静态交错 token 分配 + 动态敏捷缓存均衡适配 SpAt 偏斜。

关键数字： 大规模 chiplet 上部分预填充加速 1.45x、解码加速 1.53x（相对 SpAt 基线）。

为什么值得看： 为 chiplet 上的分布式稀疏注意力提供系统级方案，直指 agent 长上下文推理的硬件瓶颈。

item.title: InstructTTS-OPD: On-Policy Distillation for Multi-Objective Instruction-Following TTS
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-25　分类：论文PDF

Instruction-following text-to-speech (Instruct-TTS) renders a target transcript …

Instruction-following text-to-speech (Instruct-TTS) renders a target transcript in the manner described by a free-form natural-language instruction, and a good rendition must succeed on three fronts at once: following the instruction, pronouncing the transcript correctly, and sounding natural. Reinforcement learning has become the standard way to post-train such generative models toward human preferences, and TTS systems increasingly adopt it. When the three objectives are optimized together under a single scalar reward, typically with group relative policy optimization (GRPO), training tends to be unstable: the objectives compete, and the shared update drifts toward whichever one is easiest to improve, producing a seesaw among them. We instead adapt on-policy distillation (OPD), which fuses several single-objective teachers by matching their velocity fields on the student's own rollouts. Realizing this for Instruct-TTS first calls for a sound reward on each axis, which we analyze carefully: a distilled Qwen-Omni proxy for the costly Gemini judge, dialect-free data for the WER reward, and DNSMOS in place of the language-biased UTMOS. We then train three single-objective teachers wi…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Improving Tail-Augmented Speculative Drafting with Hidden State Mixing and Gradient Detach
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-25　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题： MTP 模块与 EAGLE 式草稿器自回归使用时存在训练-推理不匹配：训练喂骨干或单步 MTP 的隐藏状态序列，推理却要关注目标模型前缀加递归生成的 MTP 状态尾部；EAGLE-3 的 TTT 显式模拟但代价是额外内存与专用注意力掩码。

方法： 两个仅训练期方法：隐藏状态混合（HSM）在骨干与 MTP 对齐同一预测目标的隐藏状态间采样，暴露混合状态而不显式模拟推理；隐藏状态梯度分离（HSGD）随机阻断隐藏状态/嵌入路径的梯度而保持前向不变。两者均不增加推理成本。

关键数字： 4 个 Nemotron 模型 + DeepSeek-V4-Pro 上，HSM 使平均接受长度最高 +52.2%（相对共同训练的 MTP）；EAGLE-3 四步 Qwen3-8B 对比中峰值保留训练内存低 48% 且接受率与 TTT 相当。

为什么值得看： 免费获得 TTT 级草稿质量且省近半训练内存，长/短草稿场景各有最优解。

item.title: High-performance metapopulation models for epidemic emergencies: Scalability and performance of implicit and explicit mobility representations on CPUs and GPUs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.DC)　发布：2026-11-25　分类：论文PDF

Epidemics form a subclass of natural disasters impacting countries or entire con…

Epidemics form a subclass of natural disasters impacting countries or entire continents, where suitable reactions might differ substantially across spatio-temporal dimensions. Spatially resolved models based on ordinary differential equations (ODEs) are an efficient modeling approach for large and distributed populations. Commonly referred to as metapopulation models, they allow a realistic representation of spatial heterogeneities and mobility. Yet, their application in epidemic settings under high time pressure requires efficient, parallelized implementations leveraging modern supercomputers. The different ways to represent mobility in metapopulation models affect both epidemic trajectories and computational costs. In contrast to implicit mobility modeling, where populations are coupled through transition and transmission intensities, explicit Lagrangian mobility tracks traveling subpopulations according to their home and current location. In this paper, we compare metapopulation models with implicit and explicit mobility. A four-patch experiment shows that the trajectories of both formulations remain close, but differences increase with the mobility cycle length. We present CPU-…

item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.AR)　发布：2026-11-25　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题： 复合预取器需要策略选择算法把系统反馈映射到合适预取策略，现有方法只用少量特征（系统状态可见性不足）且片上资源限制只能用简单映射机制，难以导航大策略空间。

方法： GPS 数据驱动框架：综合 profiling 采集丰富的系统行为与硬件资源状态特征，离线学习特征到"IPC 最优策略"的映射；策略生成下沉到软件，运行时仅按预生成策略提示轻量执行，消除在线探索成本。

关键数字： 性能差距缩小到 2.6%（此前 SOTA 方法为 13.6%/14.2%）；SPEC CPU2006/2017/GAP 上几何平均 IPC 分别超 I-POP 12.14%/8.34%/14.17%；运行时仅需 778 bits 额外片上存储。

为什么值得看： 用离线学习+轻量运行时破解"策略空间大 vs 片上资源少"的矛盾，收益显著且硬件代价极小。

item.title: From Prediction to Decision: Decision-Focused Fine-Tuning of Autoregressive Tabular Transformers for Cost-Sensitive Financial Events
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-25　分类：论文PDF

Autoregressive transformers trained on tokenized tabular event streams are a sim…

Autoregressive transformers trained on tokenized tabular event streams are a simple and strong baseline for predicting financial events such as fraud. Yet institutions do not act on probabilities; they act on decisions whose consequences are asymmetric and heteroscedastic: the cost of a missed high-value fraud and that of a wrongly declined small purchase are not the same. The standard bridge is post-hoc Bayes-optimal thresholding of calibrated probabilities under a cost matrix. We ask whether fine-tuning the model to the decision objective can do better. We fine-tune the same pretrained model so that its restricted softmax over label tokens (already a distribution over business actions) maximizes expected utility under an institution-specified, amount-scaled cost matrix. Because the reward is a known function of (action, outcome, amount) and the outcome is observed in the data, the expected-utility objective and its gradient are available in closed form. This is example-dependent cost-sensitive learning whose per-example loss is linear in the predicted probability, with no sampling, critics, or advantage estimation. item.title: From Entropy Source to Stochastic Bit-Stream: Low-Cost Converters for True-Random Stochastic Computing
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.AR)　发布：2026-11-25　分类：论文PDF

Stochastic computing (SC) encodes values as the probability of ones in random bi…

Stochastic computing (SC) encodes values as the probability of ones in random bit-streams, which allows arithmetic circuits with very low area and power and a natural tolerance to faults. The accuracy and security of an SC system depend on the quality of those bit-streams. Conventional generators build them from pseudo-random or quasi-random sequences, which are predictable, periodic, and correlated across streams drawn from the same generator. This work proposes three methods for converting the unbiased outputs of a true random number generator (TRNG) into stochastic bit-streams (SBS) with arbitrary target probabilities: a block extraction and comparison circuit, a counter-logic circuit, and a cascaded majority-logic pipeline. All three accept bits from any true- random source and are built from standard CMOS logic. They reach the accuracy of a software random generator for both independent and correlated stream generation, and they support the common SC arithmetic operations with error that falls with stream length at the same rate. Hardware synthesis results show that the converters offer favorable area, energy, and area-delay trade-offs relative to pseudo- and quasi-random base…

item.title: FEAST: Fair and Efficient Adaptive Sampling for Task-Free On-Policy Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-25　分类：论文PDF

Language agents trained from self-generated experience must allocate a limited r…

Language agents trained from self-generated experience must allocate a limited rollout budget across heterogeneous capabilities. A common strategy is to prioritize capabilities with strong current learning signals, but in on-policy learning these signals are endogenous: past allocation changes the policy and therefore the evidence available for future allocation. This can create a feedback loop in which under-trained capabilities receive increasingly fewer opportunities to improve. We formalize this effect through the Quota-Efficiency Law (QEL), which shows that allocation history can change learning efficiency even under matched capability-specific exposure. Motivated by this, we introduce FEAST, a task-free adaptive sampling framework that separates opportunity allocation from compute allocation. FEAST dynamically discovers capability clusters while preserving their learning histories, maintains continued sampling opportunities across clusters, and reserves a rollout budget for each selected cluster. Within each budget, it progressively concentrates computation on prompts with informative reward variation. Across GURU-18K and SMC, FEAST improves average performance over competiti…

item.title: DéjàVu: Plurality Consensus by First Repetition
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.DC)　发布：2026-11-25　分类：论文PDF

We analyze DéjàVu, a simple protocol for plurality consensus: in each synchronou…

We analyze DéjàVu, a simple protocol for plurality consensus: in each synchronous round, each agent samples one uniformly random agent and adopts the first opinion it observes twice, resetting its memory after every adoption. The rule requires neither frequency counters nor knowledge of the population size or the number of opinions. It relies only on repetition detection, an ability documented in single neurons and reflected in the mere-exposure effect. For a population of $n$ agents with $k$ initial opinions, let $M_0$ be the initial count of the plurality opinion (so $n/M_0 \le k$) and $Δ_0$ its bias, the difference between $M_0$ and the count of the second most popular opinion. We prove that, whenever $Δ_0 = Ω(\sqrt{M_0 \log n})$, DéjàVu reaches consensus on the initial plurality opinion within $O(\sqrt{n/M_0} \log(e M_0 / Δ_0) + \log\log n)$ rounds with high probability. Moreover, we show that, for the same bias regime, DéjàVu is asymptotically never slower than the $h$-majority protocol, collecting its $h$ samples one per round, for every fixed choice of $h$, even one chosen optimally for the initial configuration. item.title: DuoMI: Dual Mutual Information Regularization for Expert Reuse in Looped Transformers
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-25　分类：论文PDF

We introduce Dual Mutual Information Regularization (DuoMI), a method for regula…

We introduce Dual Mutual Information Regularization (DuoMI), a method for regulating expert routing across rounds in looped mixture-of-experts (MoE) Transformers. When two rounds of computation share an expert pool, their routers may favor different expert subsets, limiting the reuse of individual expert parameters across rounds. Even when aggregate expert usage is identical across rounds, we would still prefer each token to retain some experts while switching to others. DuoMI addresses both aspects of routing: it uses round-level marginal mutual information to limit the dependence of aggregate expert usage on the round, and token-level conditional mutual information to penalize average cross-round routing changes that fall outside a target interval. During training, DuoMI computes differentiable penalties from soft routing distributions over all experts. It adds no model parameters and leaves sparse Top-$k$ routing strategy unchanged at inference. On a looped OLMoE backbone in which paired adjacent layers share experts, DuoMI improves the average score across $15$ downstream tasks from $50.08\%$ to $51.82\%$, a gain of $1.74$ percentage points over the looped baseline.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: DiffER$^2$: Diffusion Ensembles for Retrosynthesis Prediction with SMILES Adapted Particle Guidance
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-25　分类：论文PDF

Computational retrosynthesis prediction has the potential to reduce development …

Computational retrosynthesis prediction has the potential to reduce development time for newly discovered drugs by automatically generating potential reactions for a target product. Data-driven approaches commonly treat this as a sequence-to-sequence generation task on SMILES strings. In this work, we construct ensembles of discrete-time and continuous-time diffusion models for molecular generation and incorporate guidance mechanisms for improved output diversity. We propose an adaptation of particle guidance to SMILES sequence generation which significantly improves the number of unique molecules generated by diffusion ensembles while increasing top-k accuracy. These results further expand the efficacy of discrete diffusion for SMILES generation, and our empirical analyses offer new insights into the capabilities of diffusion models for chemical retrosynthesis.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Decentralized Clustered Federated Learning for Cellular Traffic Forecasting over LEO Constellations
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-25　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题： LEO 星座作为 6G 非地面网络的轨道边缘计算节点，训练面临地面蜂窝流量异构、与地面站链路间歇、卫星轨道运动不断改变观测数据三重挑战，去中心化联邦学习如何适配？

方法： 将去中心化联邦聚类（DFCA）扩展到 LEO：卫星仅通过 k 近邻星间 gossip 协作、无地面聚合器；零样本头选择让每颗卫星专精于当前下方地面单元的潜在流量模式。

关键数字： K=20 个训练后轨道快照平均，RMSE 比等价容量的去中心化 FedAvg 基线降 15.3%；聚类恢复准确率 85.3%（Telecom Italia Milan+Trentino 数据集）。

为什么值得看： 首个在真实蜂窝流量数据上验证 LEO 轨道边缘聚簇联邦学习增益的工作，为 6G 星地一体智能提供实证。

item.title: DLaR: Dynamic Stochasticity Control for Latent Reasoning in Large Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-25　分类：论文PDF

Latent reasoning enables LLMs to operate in continuous embedding space, yet exis…

Latent reasoning enables LLMs to operate in continuous embedding space, yet existing methods suffer from deterministic inference that precludes exploration of diverse reasoning paths. While recent approaches inject stochasticity to restore exploration, we identify two fundamental limitations: \textit{uniform stochasticity} across all steps is suboptimal, and unconstrained perturbations disrupt reasoning coherence. We propose Dynamic Stochasticity Control for Latent Reasoning (DLaR), a framework with two complementary mechanisms that operate at different temporal granularities within the GRPO reinforcement learning framework. At the token level, Adaptive Stochasticity Modulation (ASM) dynamically adjusts perturbation intensity at each latent step based on a confidence-entropy fusion signal, increasing exploration when the model is uncertain and preserving stability when confident. At the training level, Training-Aware Stochasticity Tuning (TAST) progressively decays the base stochasticity level following a curriculum schedule. Through this dual-level design, DLaR establishes a hierarchical exploration-exploitation strategy that operates at both token and training levels. Extensive e…

item.title: CovNovBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating Time Series Foundation Models under Covariate Novelty
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-25　分类：论文PDF

Covariate-aware time-series foundation models (TSFMs) condition their forecasts …

Covariate-aware time-series foundation models (TSFMs) condition their forecasts on additional input variables, called covariates, that are supplied over the future horizon. This capability makes them appealing for interventional forecasting, in which a target is predicted under a planned action such as a new product pricing policy or a new patient treatment schedule. We refer to covariates that encode such actions as treatment covariates. Current covariate-aware TSFMs, however, are trained on observed patterns, and their behavior is unclear when future treatment covariates fall outside the range seen in the history. Examples include a numerical treatment that leaves its historical range and a categorical treatment that takes a previously unseen policy. We call this practically common setting covariate novelty, and note that it is not systematically represented in existing benchmarks. We introduce an operational definition of covariate novelty and use it to construct CovNovBench, a benchmark of 88,476 evaluation series generated or filtered from four simulator-based and real-world datasets. The benchmark spans categorical and numerical treatment covariates as well as stable and tren…

item.title: CoordRoute: Coordinated Multi-Model Routing for Maximum Compute-Budget Utility
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.DC)　发布：2026-11-25　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题： 模型路由把每个请求发给不同规模的 LLM，但实际请求共享固定计算预算（API 花费上限或私有 GPU 集群容量），现有路由器逐请求独立决策，局部最优并非全局最优。

方法： CoordRoute 做协调路由：predict-plan-rectify——预测各模型会给什么结果与成本；对后续请求做前瞻规划（为每个选择计入其算力本可为后续请求赚取的效用）；生成中做预算感知的运行时修正（同价格升降级在途请求，只在值得时检查答案）。

关键数字： 在 Azure Conversation 与 BurstGPT 轨迹上，总满意度比最强现有路由器提升 18.72%。

为什么值得看： 把"预算约束下的整体效用最大化"显式建模进路由，比逐请求贪心更贴合真实部署约束。

item.title: Can image generation help visual reasoning? An empirical study
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-25　分类：论文PDF

Language models think in words; then multimodal models might think in images. We…

Language models think in words; then multimodal models might think in images. We test whether a generated helper improves the answer to a visual question. A model describes the helper it needs and then answers using the original and generated images together. Across 13 vision-language model and generator pairs, generation lowers mean accuracy by 3.7 percentage points, with declines on nine of ten tasks. Two unified models, BAGEL and Janus-Pro-7B, each lose accuracy on eight tasks. On VSTAR, adding a generated image to the same planning hint lowers accuracy by 10.47 points. Repeated image edits yield different outcomes across tasks. ChartQAPro and MathVista stay below their no-generation baselines, while ERQA gains three points after ten edits.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: CARROT: Competitive Adaptive Graph Clustering via Semi-Relaxed Optimal Transport
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-25　分类：论文PDF

Deep graph clustering (DGC) has emerged as a prominent paradigm for unsupervised…

Deep graph clustering (DGC) has emerged as a prominent paradigm for unsupervised attributed graph clustering. However, existing methods often struggle with two practical challenges encountered in real-world applications: the number of clusters $K$ is unknown a priori, and cluster sizes are frequently highly imbalanced. Methods relying on a pre-specified $K$ may fail to recover the underlying clustering structure when $K$ is misspecified, while many approaches implicitly favor balanced partitions, hindering the discovery of minority clusters. We propose CARROT, a Competitive Adaptive gRaph clustering framework via semi-Relaxed Optimal Transport, which introduces semi-relaxed optimal transport into deep graph clustering to jointly address both challenges. CARROT first pre-trains node embeddings to establish a meaningful embedding space, and then jointly optimizes embeddings and cluster assignments through an Adaptive Clustering Mechanism. The mechanism combines semi-relaxed optimal transport to adapt cluster capacities to the underlying data, a competition loss to concentrate mass onto well-supported cluster prototypes, thereby starving degenerate ones, and hard pruning to progressiv…

item.title: BReD: Block Replay Dithering for Stable Low-Bit EMA Optimizer States
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-25　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题： 低比特优化器状态并非只量化一次——每训练步都要反量化、更新、再量化、写回，这种迭代量化会破坏训练稳定性；EMA 状态的量化误差被递归喂入后续更新，偏差误差随时间累积。

方法： BReD（块重放抖动）将经典减性抖动适配到优化器状态量化：确定性种子重放 + 块级共享抖动值，避免辅助随机张量存储与逐元素抖动生成，降低舍入偏差并控制舍入方差。

关键数字： 默认预训练设置（5 个优化器 @120M；AdamW 与 Muon @1.1B/3.4B）及 SFT（7B）下，4-bit 与全精度几乎一致：预训练 PPL 偏移 ≤0.5、微调 ≤0.2、下游性能平均变化在 0.7 点内；3-bit 仍保持稳定收敛。

为什么值得看： 大模型训练内存可显著下降而质量几乎无损，3-bit 提供更激进选项，代码已开源。

item.title: Asymmetric Speculative Decoding: Unlocking In-Context Learning in Draft Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.DC)　发布：2026-11-25　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题： 投机解码实际加速远低于理论界（推理任务尤甚）——根因是任务同构性：两个模型拿到相同提示，草稿模型被迫解决超出其能力的问题，高拒绝率抵消并行收益。

方法： 发现生成过程中接受率单调上升，揭示潜在的上下文学习（ICL）效应：草稿模型从已验证 token 中学习并逐步对齐目标分布。据此提出 AsymSpec：解耦草稿/目标模型提示，给草稿模型任务相关示例解答，把目标从"推理"改为"模拟"，从头放大 ICL 效应；证明其产生精确样本且指数级收敛到目标分布。

关键数字： 推理、代码生成与摘要任务上相对自回归解码 2.29x–4.95x 加速，超过标准投机解码，无需模型重训练。

为什么值得看： 训练无关的即插即用方案，精准定位并修复投机解码的提示设计缺陷。

item.title: Assessing the Physical Interpretability of AlphaEarth Foundation Embeddings Through Multi-Sensor Satellite Time-Series Benchmarking for Agricultural Mapping
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-25　分类：论文PDF

Accurate and dynamic maps of agricultural LULC are important for agricultural wa…

Accurate and dynamic maps of agricultural LULC are important for agricultural water resource management, particularly in areas where water scarcity is prevalent, such as Morocco. Here, we evaluate the utility of AlphaEarth Foundation Model (AEF) embeddings for agricultural LULC and irrigation-type mapping in Morocco. AEF embeddings were compared to single-date and time-series remote-sensing features using three machine-learning classifiers: XGBoost, CatBoost, and TabPFN. We also evaluated whether AEF embeddings can: (a) provide an efficient and transferable alternative to conventional direct use of Earth observation products and (b) reconstruct biophysical information. Results showed that multi-temporal feature time series achieved the highest performance, with accuracies of 0.93 for agricultural LULC and 0.87 for irrigation-type mapping when using TabPFN. However, AEF embeddings yielded comparable results, achieving accuracies of 0.91 for agricultural LULC and 0.85 for irrigation-type mapping, while reducing the need for extensive data processing and manual feature engineering typically required for satellite products. item.title: Any-Rate: Half-Bit Multi-Precision LLM Quantization with Coded Bit-Planes
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-25　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题： 嵌套多精度量化从单一 checkpoint 按权重前导位读取多种精度，但只支持整数位，相邻精度间准确率缺口大、2 位下严重退化。

方法： Any-Rate 从单个 checkpoint 提供 2–8 位、2–4 位间以半比特步进：部分位平面限制为 8 权重块的扩展 Hamming 码字（每权重 0.5 位）、每行跨精度共享一个 LUT、所有精度联合编码并各设独立目标以降低共享损失。

关键数字： 4 个 LLM 上 2/3 位达到多精度方法 SOTA，2 位保持 FP16 准确率的 69%；4 位距最优在 1 点以内；LPDDR 能耗模型估计同等准确率下能耗最高降 27%。

为什么值得看： 单 checkpoint 覆盖半比特粒度多精度，适配端侧波动内存/能耗预算，代码已开源。

item.title: An Embedded Ergonomic Posture Monitoring and AI-Assisted Home Learning System on a Raspberry Pi 3B Edge Platform
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.AR)　发布：2026-11-25　分类：论文PDF

During independent home study sessions, students frequently sustain improper sit…

During independent home study sessions, students frequently sustain improper sitting postures, accumulate excessive sedentary hours, and experience productivity loss from off-task digital distractions. Furthermore, learners often lack real-time pedagogical scaffolding for demanding self-study curricula. To mitigate these ergonomic and instructional challenges, this paper presents an affordable, privacy-preserving cyber-physical embedded system for domestic study spaces. Engineered on a Raspberry Pi 3 Model B (1 GB RAM) paired with a UVC optical camera and a USB condenser microphone, the system executes on-device computer vision utilizing MediaPipe Pose and OpenCV to monitor upper-body alignment, sagittal head inclination, and coronal shoulder asymmetry in real time without persisting raw video streams. A deterministic finite state machine (FSM) quantifies active study durations, enforces health-compliant rest periods, and detects illicit smartphone usage. Simultaneously, an integrated multimodal AI tutoring agent parses voice and text queries via an encrypted API gateway, synthesizing Socratic conceptual hints rather than direct solutions. A lightweight parental web dashboard deliv…

item.title: An Efficient and Uniform CSP Solution Generator Generator
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.PL)　发布：2026-11-25　分类：论文PDF

Constraint-based random testing is a powerful technique which aims at generating…

Constraint-based random testing is a powerful technique which aims at generating random test cases to verify functional properties of a program. Its objective is to determine whether a function satisfies a given property for every possible input. This approach requires firstly defining the property to satisfy, then secondly to provide a generator of inputs able to feed the program with the inputs generated. Besides, function inputs often need to satisfy certain constraints to ensure the function operates correctly, which makes the crafting of such a generator a hard task. In this paper, we are interested in the problem of manufacturing a uniform and efficient generator for the solutions of a CSP. In order to do that, we propose a specialized solving method that produces a well-suited representation for random sampling. Our solving method employs a dedicated propagation scheme based on the hypergraph representation of a CSP, and a custom split heuristic called birdge-first that emphasizes the interests of our propagation scheme. The generators we build are general enough to handle a wide range of use-cases. They are moreover uniform by construction, iterative and self-improving. We …

item.title: Amortizing Exact Orthogonality: Drift-Triggered Restoration for Orthogonal Fine-Tuning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-25　分类：论文PDF

Orthogonal finetuning (OFT) adapts a pretrained weight by an orthogonal transfor…

Orthogonal finetuning (OFT) adapts a pretrained weight by an orthogonal transform and preserves its singular values and row angles, but existing methods construct an exact or approximate orthogonal transform at every optimization step. We measure how far a transform $A$ is from orthogonal by its orthogonality defect $\|A^\top A-I\|_2$. For OFTv2, which truncates a Cayley-Neumann series, we show that the truncation order does not determine the defect. At its default order, block defects in checkpoints from the reference implementation span five orders of magnitude. We propose Restarted Tangent Orthogonal Finetuning (RTOFT), which uses the first-order update $W(I+S)$ of a weight $W$ with a skew-symmetric $S$ and restores exact orthogonality by a polar decomposition only when the drift $\|S\|_2$ reaches a tolerance $τ$. The defect of $I+S$ is exactly $\|S\|_2^2$. Therefore, reading the drift after every update and restoring before the next forward pass guarantees a defect of at most $τ^2$ in every forward pass, independently of the loss, data, model, and optimizer. A final restoration makes the returned transform exactly orthogonal. On GLUE, RTOFT reduces the training time of block-di…

item.title: A gene informed benchmark for BioScoring of pathology foundation models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-25　分类：论文PDF

Pathology foundation models are usually compared by their performance on downstr…

Pathology foundation models are usually compared by their performance on downstream tasks such as classification and retrieval. While such benchmarks measure how useful a model is, they provide no insight into the biology it represents. We introduce BioScore, a benchmark that quantifies how well an image encoder captures cell identities, with spatial transcriptomics of the same tissue as the reference. A sparse autoencoder splits the encoder's patch embeddings into sparse features, which we cluster into a fixed number of groups. BioScore then measures, for each of 52 cell identities defined by marker genes, how specifically one group follows the identity's expression over the tissue. Because the autoencoder training is fully unsupervised, a match shows that the model represents the cell identity from the image alone. We score 8 pathology foundation models and 3 natural-image models. Every pathology model scores above every natural-image model (0.299--0.371 \vs 0.214--0.232), and paired tests separate three tiers among the pathology models. Unlike a supervised probe, BioScore needs no labels, builds its reference from the data and scores even from few sections, yet it ranks the enco…

A well-known application of the celebrated color-coding technique is fast detection of paths in a distributed setting with limited bandwidth, by propagating a signal along colorful paths [Even et al., DISC 2017]. However, since vertices of the same color are indistinguishable by this procedure, it cannot detect induced paths, as they appear the same as cycles. We make the following observation. If, for a given edge, we \emph{count} the number of such signals over all permutations of the random coloring that terminate at that edge, then we can separate an induced path from a cycle: an induced path contributes one to that count, while a cycle contributes two. Refining and generalizing this observation gives our \emph{local-counting approach}, which allows us to separate induced paths from any other subgraph. We establish the following end results, all improving upon the state of the art in their round complexities and refined detection variants. * An $O(1)$-round algorithm for induced $P_4$ detection. * $O(Δ)$-round algorithms for detection of induced $P_5$ and $P_6$. * An $\tilde{O}(n^{1/3})$-round algorithm for detection of induced $P_5$ in induced-$C_4$ free graphs.

item.title: A Differential Computing Accelerator for LLM Inference Leveraging Bit-Slice Transition Sparsity
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.AR)　发布：2026-11-25　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题： 位片架构分解量化操作数后主要利用高阶片的稀疏性，而稠密低阶片仍有大量未被开发的复用机会，能否进一步压缩 GEMM 计算？

方法： 观察到位片向量（BSV）在 Hamming 空间高度聚类——多数 BSV 距少量代表模式仅几次位翻转。据此提出 ISTS 算法-硬件协同加速器：用代表 BSV 作为共享 Steiner 点跨片复用部分和（目标 BSV 的部分和由 Steiner 点经少量加减重构）；算法侧 SATC 构建紧凑 Steiner 点集、FlipPrune 选择性剪枝翻转扩大可复用群体；硬件侧支持静态权重与运行时注意力 K/V。

关键数字： 相对 SOTA 加速器 ANT/BBS/LUT Tensor Core/Transitive Array/MCBP-BRCR 平均加速 3.09x/2.41x/2.18x/1.27x/1.41x。

为什么值得看： 抓住低阶片稀疏性这一被忽视的机会，覆盖 LLM 推理的静态与动态张量两类负载。

item.title: Yet Another Concept Drift Benchmark? A Principled Framework for Evaluating Drift Detectors
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF

Concept drift detection is a fundamental component of data stream learning, yet …

Concept drift detection is a fundamental component of data stream learning, yet its empirical evaluation remains based on loosely defined protocols, ambiguous alarm semantics, and inconsistent metrics. We propose a principled benchmark grounded in an explicit formulation of drift observability and alarm semantics. Our framework introduces finite detection windows and repeated alarms, enabling a clear separation between detection accuracy, timeliness, and stability, and employs a reproducible observer to provide a controlled and interpretable performance signal. Building on this formulation, we define normalized evaluation metrics and a composite score addressing limitations of existing measures. We validate the framework through a large-scale stress-testing evaluation of 10 detectors across 9 learner configurations and 16 datasets.

item.title: Wi-Fi Enabled Edge Intelligence Framework for Smart City Traffic Monitoring using Low-Power IoT Cameras
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF

Real-time traffic monitoring in smart cities demands ultra-low latency processing to support time-critical decisions such as incident detection and congestion management. While cloud-based solutions offer robust computation, their inherent latency limits their applicability for such tasks. This work proposes a localized edge AI framework that connects low-power IoT camera sensors to a client, or applies offloading of inference to an NVIDIA Jetson Nano (GPU). Networking is achieved via Wi-Fi, enabling image classification without relying on wide-area infrastructure such as 5G, or wired networks. We evaluate two processing strategies: local inference on camera nodes and GPU-accelerated offloading to the Jetson Nano.We show that local processing is only feasible for lightweight models and low frame rates, whereas offloading enables near-realtime performance even for more complex models. These results demonstrate the viability of cost-effective, Wi-Fi-based edge AI deployments for latency-critical urban monitoring.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: When Is Product Decoding of ECOC MAP-Consistent? Pair Structure and the n-vs-Rest Codes
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF

Error-Correcting Output Codes (ECOC) combine binary classifiers by the sum decoder, which totals probabilities, or the product decoder, which totals log-likelihoods. In the noiseless setting, where the binary classifiers output the true posteriors, we ask on which code matrices each decoder always agrees with the Bayes-optimal (MAP) class. For the sum decoder the answer is known: the code must be equidistant (James and Hastie, 1998). We answer the question for the product decoder. Two classes are compared through the votes of the columns on which they differ: the sum decoder decides by their sample mean, the product decoder by an M-estimator with influence function artanh, and each vote is the MAP margin plus a bias determined by the other classes alone. Our main theorem states that the product decoder is MAP-consistent if and only if, for every class pair, the columns on which the two classes differ are matched with the columns obtained by swapping the two classes (or their complements), and equivalently if and only if the code is a union of n-vs-Rest codes. Efficient equidistant codes are therefore excluded: Hadamard codes ($M\ge 8$), which meet the Plotkin bound with $M-1$ colum…

item.title: When Exact Token Importance Is Not Enough: Limits of Top-K Selection in LLM Attention
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF

Long-context language models often retain only a limited set of past token positions for an attention query. A common strategy scores positions individually and keeps the highest-ranked K. Yet attention weights are renormalized over the chosen set: two individually important positions need not form the best pair. We ask whether independent ranking suffices even when each importance score measures the exact downstream change in next-token predictions caused by deleting that position alone. It does not. A four-position construction makes the ranked pair incur 133.2 times the Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence of the optimal pair, and a parametric family proves that this multiplicative gap is unbounded. An exact exchange identity and preference reversals for every K >= 2 explain the interaction. In exhaustive frozen-model audits of SmolLM2, Gemma, and Qwen, exact-singleton Top-4 leaves at least 10% relative improvement within a fully enumerated 24-position candidate pool in 55/60, 49/60, and 60/60 cases, respectively. SwapCert, a same-budget one-swap audit, detects 157/164 such cases and returns directly checkable improving supports. A KL-margin certificate relates support fidelity to n…

item.title: Weight Scale Rebalancing: Transferable Training Recipes for Transformers
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF

Training Transformers requires careful hyperparameter tuning, which becomes increasingly costly for large models. We introduce UDV-Rebalance (UDVR), a reparameterization that inserts an auxiliary diagonal matrix $D$ between naturally paired weight matrices $(U,V)$ appearing throughout Transformer architectures. UDVR periodically rebalances the factors to maintain unit-norm columns in $U$ and unit-norm rows in $V$, with $D$ absorbing the corresponding scales. With rebalancing, a single hyperparameter setting of UDVR remains effective across model scales, architectures, and data distributions. This yields a tuning-free rule that adapts to each weight matrix using only its dimensions. We fit this rule once on ViT models trained on CIFAR-10 and CIFAR-100, and it remains valid when the activation function or the optimizer is changed. The same rule transfers to new image domains in DomainNet, to ViT, Swin, and MaxViT on ImageNet, and to language-model pretraining with up to 1.3B parameters. UDVR consistently outperforms Weight Normalization and $σ$Reparam and matches a vanilla baseline whose hyperparameters are swept on each target model.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Walk the Cycle: An Efficient Stochastic Solver for Periodic Thermal Analysis of 2.5D/3D ICs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF

Long-term periodic thermal analysis is essential for designing 2.5D/3D ICs operating under periodic workloads. Deterministic global solvers can be costly for repeated thermal queries, while existing random-walk methods are not tailored to long-term periodic problems or multiscale 3D IC structures, limiting their efficiency and accuracy. We propose CycleWalker, a periodic residual random-walk solver. First, we formulate the periodic steady state (PSS) as an infinite-history backward walk, which needs no initial temperature or warm-up but charges the full temperature field to every path. Second, to cut this cost, we let the walk estimate only the residual of a periodic prior, and shorten long histories by Russian roulette while preserving unbiasedness. Third, since the estimator constrains the prior only to be periodic and piecewise linear in time, we build it at negligible cost by a coarse-grid Fourier solve followed by fine-grid smoothing. Finally, we construct a thermal graph aware of through-silicon vias (TSVs) that bounds the walk's jump rate while retaining the anisotropic conduction of TSV arrays. item.title: WADJET: Whole-Job Authorization and Dispatch for Job Execution Trust on FPGA System-on-Chip Accelerators
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.AR)　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF

On an FPGA system-on-chip, the software that submits work to an accelerator also…

On an FPGA system-on-chip, the software that submits work to an accelerator also decides what the accelerator does. It writes the registers one by one, and the hardware runs whatever it finds, so faulty or compromised software can change one address or resend a job. Existing protections decide who may reach an accelerator or keep its data safe. Deciding whether one job was approved and is still unused takes three things in one place: the only way to the accelerator, the whole job held back until checked, and a record of used approvals. WADJET puts the three in one gate in FPGA logic. A separate authority encrypts and authenticates each approved job, with a sequence number, using Ascon-AEAD128. The gate verifies the whole job before releasing any part, accepts only a newer sequence number, uses it up, and writes the registers of an unmodified accelerator itself. The gate replaces only the processor's direct line to the registers and works beside the existing protections. In a software model, a check on each write ran jobs mixed from two approved ones; the whole-job rule released none. Its release path is proven on the Verilog for all inputs. item.title: Understanding Failure Patterns in LLM-Based Mathematical Optimization Modeling
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF

Industrial optimization involves complex constraints, making optimization modeli…

Industrial optimization involves complex constraints, making optimization modeling difficult to automate. Large language models (LLMs) have been explored for generating optimization models from natural language, but their reliability in end-to-end settings remains limited, often producing non-executable, infeasible, or feasible but incorrect solutions. In this work, we study failure modes in LLM-based optimization modeling by decomposing the process into three components: mathematical reasoning, solver usage, and domain knowledge, and constructing datasets that target each aspect. Using these datasets, we analyze how different components relate to errors and find that they are associated with different types of failure, although these relationships are not always strong or consistent. Furthermore, while combining these components improves execution reliability, feasible but incorrect solutions remain the dominant failure mode, suggesting a remaining gap between executability and correctness. These findings highlight limitations of current dataset designs and suggest the importance of data that better capture constraint completeness and formulation accuracy to enhance reliability.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: U-Statistics-Powered LLM Reasoning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF

Since its introduction by DeepSeek, group relative policy optimization (GRPO) has been widely adopted for training large reasoning models and agents, spurring a proliferation of its variants. Yet the group size, a crucial hyperparameter in these GRPO-type algorithms, remains largely chosen by trial and error. Exploiting the U-statistic structure of GRPO's policy gradient, we recast the selection of the group size as a classical statistical problem of variance ratio estimation. This problem is particularly challenging when the denominator of the ratio is small, rendering naive plug-in estimators unstable. To address this challenge, we propose a pessimistic ratio estimator that accounts for the denominator's estimation uncertainty. We characterise the statistical properties of this estimator across three sample-size regimes. Empirically, using %a jackknife-based pessimistic rule on synthetic tasks from Reasoning Gym and real-world benchmarks covering both mathematical reasoning and code generation, we show that our adaptive group size selection reduces the mean squared error of the resulting policy gradient and improves policy optimisation over fixed-group-size baselines, with modest…

Yet the group size, a crucial hyperparameter in these GRPO-type algorithms, remains largely chosen by trial and error. item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF

Today, a core pipeline of artificial intelligence systems is pretraining on a br…

Today, a core pipeline of artificial intelligence systems is pretraining on a broad range of text corpora and then fine-tuning on specific tasks or desired behaviors. Yet we still have limited understanding of how fine-tuning on a restricted data distribution modifies representations acquired during pretraining. In particular, it remains unclear whether surface behavioral suppression happens together with the erasure of latent representations that support it. In this work, we study supervised fine-tuning (SFT) by pretraining transformers on a controlled context-free grammar with hierarchical latent structure, the Random Hierarchy Model (RHM), and fine-tuning with a restricted subset of its generative rules. item.title: Trading BRAM for LUTs: Hybrid Bit-Level Weight Storage for FPGA-Based Spiking Neural Networks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：SNN 在 FPGA 部署受片上内存严重制约（需存储突触权重）；现有压缩技术在降低存储需求的同时牺牲权重精度或精度。

方法：混合位级权重存储方案，用 FPGA 逻辑资源换取 BRAM 容量且保持原权重不变：选定权重位用查找表（LUT）实现、其余位存 BRAM、推理时联合重构；集成进空间数据流 SNN 架构，并提出实用位映射启发式在 BRAM 与 LUT 逻辑间划分权重位（不修改权重）。

关键数字：BRAM 利用率降低超过 26%，LUT 与寄存器使用适度增加，总功耗显著节省。

为什么值得看：不损精度的权重存储压缩路径，为 FPGA SNN 的 BRAM 瓶颈提供新解法。

item.title: Tokenization and Architecture Jointly Allocate Component Roles in Time Series Transformers
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF

Time series transformers have achieved strong forecasting performance, yet it remains unclear which of their components, attention or the feed-forward network (FFN), constructs temporal features, and how tokenization such as patching changes this. We propose a temporal probing framework that uses 15 token-level diagnostic tasks to measure feature construction as the gain in linear decodability of temporal properties from one sub-layer to the next (a matched MLP probe already saturates at the embedding). It targets models whose probed representations are read by a linear forecasting head. Applied to 5 supervised models trained on 8 long-term forecasting benchmarks, it finds that the constructing component is not fixed but allocated by the interaction of tokenization and architecture. Under patch tokenization (PatchTST), the FFN's gain exceeds attention's in probing on all 8 datasets, and its 8-dataset mean is 3.2x attention's. Without attention, the FFN alone reaches nearly the same total gain, both when attention is removed from a trained model and when PatchTST is trained without it, and the retrained model forecasts within a few percent of the full model. item.title: The Teacher Is Already Inside: Self-Distilling Looped Language Models Beyond Their Last Loop
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF

Looped language models apply one shared transformer stack several times per token, and every loop is readable through the shared language-model head. Post-training them is hard. Reward-only reinforcement learning needs a verifier and learns from one sparse signal per response; spreading the reward over loops collapses the entropy of every loop; and cross-loop self-distillation, as in LoopOPD, can only teach intermediate loops, because the last loop cannot learn from its own frozen copy: the loss is zero at initialisation. We observe that a looped model already contains a policy that decodes better than its last loop: the next-token distribution extrapolated from the first loop through the last. ELPSD (Extrapolated-Loop Policy Self-Distillation) turns this distribution into a self-distillation target: a frozen copy of the model computes it, and the model's own last loop is distilled towards it on its own rollouts, using the exact reverse KL at every visited prefix. Teacher and student are the same model, so ELPSD needs no reward, no external teacher and no privileged context, and it leaves rollouts and decoding unchanged. item.title: The Geometry Is the Memory: Task-Density Routing for Continual LoRA
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题： 冻结旧 adapter 并不能保证持续学习者在推理时正确选择使用它们——存在多个 adapter 时，如何路由到表示空间与查询答案匹配的那个？

方法： CONTLORA 用紧凑类统计替代存储示例：冻结表示上的高斯类模型选择 LoRA adapter，累积特征矩精确恢复类平衡 ridge 分类器；无需保留图像或特征向量即可完成选择与分类。

关键数字： 20-task CIFAR-100 达 88.55% 准确率、CUB-200 达 86.99%；匹配组件研究中，与独立训练的存储特征对应物的平均最终准确率相差不超过 0.07 个百分点。

为什么值得看： 为"统计记忆 vs 示例保留"提供实证：内存占用大幅降低而精度几乎无损，是持续 LoRA 落地的实用方案。

item.title: Temporal Selective Exploration for Reinforcement Learning-Guided Continuous-Discrete Flow Matching in 3D Molecular Design
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF

Flow matching has shown strong potential in generative tasks, while its optimiza…

Flow matching has shown strong potential in generative tasks, while its optimization via Reinforcement Learning (RL) remains underexplored, especially in continuous-discrete mixed settings. Moreover, flow matching is formulated as an Ordinary Differential Equation (ODE), whose deterministic trajectories do not naturally support RL optimization. Introducing stochasticity by converting the entire trajectory into a Stochastic Differential Equation (SDE) is a common practice. Nevertheless, not all timesteps contribute to the final outcomes, and redundant exploration introduces additional noise. Furthermore, in multi-objective settings, some objectives may dominate the optimization while others receive insufficient updates. In this study, we propose an RL-guided continuous-discrete flow matching framework with temporal selective exploration for 3D de novo molecular design. Specifically, our method jointly optimizes continuous and discrete flow matching for atomic coordinates and molecular identities, respectively, while restricting exploration to timesteps that primarily contribute to target properties, reducing ineffective exploration. item.title: Tabra Blends: Improving the Accuracy--Latency Trade-off with Complementary Tabular Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF

Tabular foundation models make different trade-offs between prediction accuracy and latency. We study whether a compact ensemble can deliver higher accuracy in less time. Across 816 TabArena splits, our blend of four-estimator Kumo and one LimiX pipeline reaches 2063.8 Elo, 45.4 points above the top published entry in the same fit. Its normalized fit + predict time is 15% lower than Kumo-16's and 98% lower than full LimiX's. We find that greater prediction diversity between the two models helps explain the reduction in error.

item.title: TQ-HQNet: A Trainability-Aware and Qubit-Efficient Hybrid Quantum Neural Network for Cross-Domain Learning on Heterogeneous Data
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF

Hybrid quantum neural networks are a promising direction for noisy intermediate-scale quantum computing, but their practical effectiveness is often limited by poor trainability, rigid circuit design, and weak robustness across heterogeneous real-world tasks. This paper proposes TQ-HQNet, a Trainability-Aware and Qubit-Efficient Hybrid Quantum Neural Network for cross-domain learning on heterogeneous data. The proposed framework combines three mechanisms: 1) adaptive latent compression to map domain-specific features into qubit-compatible representations, 2) trainability-aware search over compact variational circuit candidates, and 3) hybrid fusion of multiple shallow quantum experts to improve robustness without increasing qubit cost excessively. TQ-HQNet is evaluated on four public datasets spanning neurological screening, phishing detection, financial direction prediction, and DNA sequence classification. Across all domains, the proposed model consistently improves over a fixed hybrid quantum baseline, with balanced-accuracy gains of +0.280, +0.170, +0.071, and +0.060, respectively. item.title: Structure-Aware Transformers for Hierarchical Authorization in Personal AI Agents
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF

Personal AI agents can carry out complex, multi-step tasks on users' behalf, but doing so often involves numerous permission requests. Manually reviewing each request is time-consuming, while indiscriminate approval poses privacy and security risks. Predicting users' authorization preferences offers a way to reduce this burden while preserving user control. However, authorization prediction is challenging because permission requests are often hierarchical and observed user decisions are sparse and potentially correlated. To address these challenges, We propose the Parent-gated Authorization Transformer for Hierarchies (PATH) to predict users' authorization preferences for personal AI agents. PATH is a novel neural network architecture that combines hierarchy-aware attention masks with a parent-gated probability formulation to ensure hierarchy-consistent predictions. Hierarchy-level embeddings further support learning from sparse observations and patterns shared within each authorization level. We establish finite-sample risk bounds and provide sufficient conditions for consistent authorization probability estimation and algorithmic convergence. Experiments on simulated data, AI-gen…

item.title: Steerable by Design: Conditional Pretraining for Robust Control of Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF

Our goal is to build language models that are steerable by design. Today's language models are pretrained with next-token prediction, which relegates alignment and control to the final 1% of training tokens or inference-time interventions. These models repurpose a single input channel for both instructions and data, leading to common failure modes where the model mistakenly treats data as instructions such as intentional jailbreaks and unintentional in-context alignment drift. To correct this, we propose a pretraining method and architecture that separates the two from the very start, producing Mancelle-3B. An encoder processes high-level semantic features of upcoming text with cross-attention that prevents the token stream from writing back into this control channel. During pretraining, the model learns to rely on these features to predict the next token, turning the channel into an effective handle for steering the model. Mancelle-3B steers more strongly than prompt- and activation-based methods on comparable open models while maintaining fluency, and it withstands adversarial black-box and soft-prompt counter-steering that defeats those baselines. item.title: Sounding the Black Box: Online Training of Embedded Neural Networks in Forward-Only Physical Simulators
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF

Hybrid physics-neural simulators embed neural networks in partial differential equation (PDE) solvers to model unresolved subgrid dynamics while preserving resolved physics and conservation laws. Because closure outputs feed back across time steps, single-step offline regression does not directly minimize multi-step rollout error, motivating online trajectory optimization. Solver backpropagation through time (BPTT) is the standard online solution when solver derivatives are available, yet many operational Fortran and C/C++ simulators expose only non-differentiable, forward-only interfaces. We introduce FORGE (Forward-Only Response and Gauss-Newton Estimation), an online framework that trains embedded networks from forward runs alone by decoupling exact network derivatives from black-box simulator dynamics. Stage I warms up the rollout via a low-dimensional Gauss-Newton step along output-orthonormal weight directions, canceling multi-layer feature drift via a final-layer correction. 发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF

Hybrid physics-neural simulators embed neural networks in partial differential equation (PDE) solvers to model unresolved subgrid dynamics while preserving resolved physics and conservation laws. Because closure outputs feed back across time steps, single-step offline regression does not directly minimize multi-step rollout error, motivating online trajectory optimization. Solver backpropagation through time (BPTT) is the standard online solution when solver derivatives are available, yet many operational Fortran and C/C++ simulators expose only non-differentiable, forward-only interfaces. We introduce FORGE (Forward-Only Response and Gauss-Newton Estimation), an online framework that trains embedded networks from forward runs alone by decoupling exact network derivatives from black-box simulator dynamics. Stage I warms up the rollout via a low-dimensional Gauss-Newton step along output-orthonormal weight directions, canceling multi-layer feature drift via a final-layer correction.
