item.title: Sound Distributed Runtime Verification under Incomplete Evidence
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF

Distributed runtime verification often requires combining evidence from several nodes to check properties that cannot be evaluated locally. However, when messages are delayed, lost, or deliberately suppressed, the verifier may not know whether a violation occurred or whether the relevant evidence is missing. This creates a risk of incorrectly reporting compliance. We study the requirements for sound monitoring under these conditions. We first show that a deadline-bounded monitor cannot be simultaneously sound, decisive, and available when an adversary can suppress evidence. The monitor must therefore be able to abstain. We then distinguish two sources of incomplete evidence. Sequence numbers and periodic reports can identify missing events, whereas detecting silent streams requires timing assumptions. We also examine how membership changes and coordinator failures affect verdict soundness and recovery. We implement these mechanisms in a three-tier monitoring architecture using MQTT and NATS JetStream. Experiments with an LLM-planned robot swarm demonstrate the failure modes, show how the proposed mechanisms prevent unsupported compliance verdicts, and measure their runtime and comm…

item.title: Shifter Quantization: Compact Representations for Native Integer Computation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：LLM 量化中分组（groupwise）量化提升低位宽精度，但分组权重使标准整数 MMA 无法覆盖完整点积，阻碍高效 GPU 推理。

方法：Shifter Quantization（SQ）通过追加并移位共享位来重建原生宽度整数操作数；为延伸效率，开发 SQ 的特例 Shifter Integer（SHI）以使用 INT4 kernel。

关键数字：2-bit 精度下，SQ2/SHI2 在 Q2_K 检查点上 4,096-token prefill 吞吐为 llama.cpp 的 2.71-3.77x，WikiText-2 KL 降 6.6-7.8%；4-bit 下 SQ4 的 prefill 吞吐为 NInfer 分组整数基线的 1.43-2.47x、KL 低 24-40%；8-bit 下 SQ8 的 batch-one prefill 吞吐较 vLLM 在线 FP8 高 27.4%、KL 低 72.7%。

为什么值得看：让分组量化与原生整数 MMA 兼容的表示设计，低位宽推理精度与速度双赢。

item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF

The goal of continual learning (CL) is to adapt to new data (plasticity) while r…

The goal of continual learning (CL) is to adapt to new data (plasticity) while retaining the knowledge acquired from old data (stability). Existing methods are explicitly designed to focus on balancing stability and plasticity to mitigate the challenge of catastrophic forgetting while promoting learning. However, the impact of order and nature of samples from the new data that the network is trained on remains an under explored factor. We argue that a CL algorithm should have the ability to rank incoming samples in terms of their relationship with prior data and their effect on the learning process. In this work, we investigate if scoring and prioritizing incoming data based on their semantic relationships with the model's current knowledge can benefit CL. We propose SACK, short for Sequentially Acquiring Concept Knowledge, a plug and play technique for continual learning methods. item.title: See the Answer, Learn to Embed: Learning Universal Multimodal Embeddings from Hindsight
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF

Universal Multimodal Embedding (UME) models map heterogeneous multimodal inputs into a shared embedding space, where pairwise similarity supports diverse downstream tasks. Recent reasoning-driven UME approaches use intermediate reasoning to generate additional context for embedding, but often incur extra computation at inference. In this paper, we explore the matched candidate (i.e., the paired target) as an alternative source of context, asking whether a model can "see the answer" during training and "learn to embed" without it at inference. However, direct conditioning on this privileged context can introduce candidate-specific information unavailable from the query alone or cause the candidate-conditioned query representation to collapse toward the candidate embedding. To address this, we introduce Hindsight-Enhanced Multimodal Embeddings (HEME), which learns query-grounded hindsight representations from such candidate context. HEME first trains a hindsight teacher with a hindsight attention mask, mismatched-candidate conditioning, and query-token alignment to limit excessive reliance on the candidate. item.title: Score-Based Diffusion for Hypergraph Signals in the t-Spectral Domain
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF

We introduce the first score-based generative model for signals on a fixed hypergraph, formulated in the spectral domain of t-product hypergraph signal processing (t-HGSP). The naive tensor heat semigroup is ill-posed, since after palindromic symmetrization the spectral slices of the Laplacian tensor are no longer positive semidefinite. A per-mode frequency shift repairs it, yielding a forward Ornstein-Uhlenbeck diffusion that decouples per (eigenmode, slice) pair with closed-form marginals, exact score targets, and an exactly isotropic stationary law. A lightweight slice-conditioned denoiser is trained on the resulting real spectral grid. Sampling combines its score on data-active modes with the closed-form score elsewhere, which proves essential for stability at scale. A closed cosine-form observation operator turns missing-node recovery into linear-Gaussian guidance with stabilized posterior sampling. On hypergraphs of up to 500 nodes, our model beats a clique-expansion baseline by margins growing from $2\times$ to $27\times$ in covariance error, matches the graph-spectral statistics of the data better than the graph-basis model itself, and reaches the finite-sample estimation f…

item.title: Scalpel and Brush: Pruning and Targeted Weight Editing of a Small Language Model by a Single LLM Agent
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题： LLM 能编辑另一语言模型的权重，但结果有多少真正来自 agent？随机编辑、提示指令或标准流程能否复现同样效果？

方法： 把修复与剪枝统一为稀疏权重编辑（以 BLEU 为例）：三项任务——定向权重修复（"brush"）、结构化 MLP 神经元剪枝（"scalpel"）、层移除+修复——交给 DeepSeek Harness agent（DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash），每任务最多 50 次开发评估，Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B-Instruct 上每任务独立跑 3 次。

关键数字： 最多改动 0.0084% 权重使 ODE 测试 BLEU 提升 24–32%；移除 12.5–15% 神经元使模型缩小 9.4–11.2% 且 BLEU 损失 ≤0.01；GoEmotions 宏 F1 从 0.100 升至 0.396–0.451（测试集）。

为什么值得看： 严格对照揭示：一旦给出干预位置与形式，无 LLM 的标准流程可复现大部分性能——agent 的真实增量需要更严谨的归因。

item.title: Scaling Laws of Ensemble Uncertainty in Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF

Many use cases for large language models (LLMs)---from AI safety to exploration and human interaction---can benefit from epistemic uncertainty estimates. We argue that existing Bayesian Deep Learning solutions, which are often restricted to a fixed model family, fail to capture the full epistemic uncertainty at practical LLM scales. This is because the error due to the bounded capacity of the model family remains invisible to disagreement among models supported by the prior. We relate this error to the well-known power-law scaling of LLM loss with model size. We then show that a second power law quantifies the shrinking disagreement within ensembles as model size increases. Its slower decay relative to the capacity law above suggests that ensembles capture a growing share of epistemic uncertainty and become more competitive as an axis for scaling, compared to a single larger model. Finally, a third power law quantifies the loss of ensemble diversity as members share a larger fraction of training before branching, and therefore identifies a further limitation, beyond the capacity error, for LoRA ensembles and optimization-based or second-order methods that approximate uncertainty ar…

item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：详细架构仿真的成本限制设计空间探索，而跨仿真核并行对单核与小型多核目标只能提供有限的宿主并发。

方法：GIPSim 指令驱动仿真器：从依赖与资源约束推导指令时序，降低逐周期更新流水线状态的开销；同步引导的时间分解对记录的执行进行切分，暴露超出目标核数的宿主并行；并行重放片段并用依赖图聚合时长估计总执行时间，重放上下文用保留的微架构状态、预热与同步引导缓存驱逐重建。

关键数字：x86-64、AArch64、RV64GC 多核 QEMU trace 上，单 worker 平均仿真吞吐 13.8 MIPS、96 worker 达 1,010 MIPS、峰值 1,421 MIPS；相对 gem5 的执行周期平均绝对百分比误差分别为 7.52% 与 7.43%。

为什么值得看：把架构仿真推到每秒千兆指令量级，大幅降低设计空间探索成本。

item.title: Scalable Placement for Disaggregated LLM Serving on Heterogeneous Edge Fleets
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：边缘 LLM 服务受有限计算资源与设备异构性制约，突发需求下拥塞与排队显著增加响应延迟；把模型复制到多个流水线实例可提升服务容量，但设备分组、副本分配与跨设备层划分联合构成大型组合优化问题。

方法：Spade 可扩展运行时高效放置规划器（异构边缘集群上带流水线复制的分离式 LLM 服务）：支配剪枝丢弃劣质副本候选、递归消除包含它们的更大候选，大幅收缩搜索空间；water-filling 层划分 + 有界多维背包公式在拥塞感知目标下优化放置。

关键数字：30 设备（5 种硬件类别）合成集群 441ms 找到最优放置；遗传搜索基线 + DP 划分约需 2 小时且拥塞目标仍差 19.7%；10 种设备类型集群上剪枝消除 99.6% 候选放置，同时与穷举产生相同幸存候选集。

为什么值得看：异构边缘集群 LLM 放置的实用可扩展规划器，剪枝效果显著。

item.title: Sample-Efficient In-Context Adaptation via Sleep
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF

The ability to learn and generalize from limited experience, or sample efficiency, is a cornerstone of intelligence. How can we build language models that turn a few user interactions, a few snippets of unfamiliar code, or a handful of experimental results provided in context into knowledge that generalizes? Prior work has found that sleep, a process where the model performs $N$ recurrent forward passes to refine its representations of a chunk of context, can improve long-context reasoning (specifically, within SSM-attention hybrid models). We study whether this method also improves in-context adaptation on general, non-synthetic tasks for transformer language models. To this end, we pre-train language models up to 1.2B-parameters on up to 100B tokens with sleep mechanisms. Notably, longer sleep (i.e., using a larger number of recurrent forward passes $N$) enables the model to learn faster in-context on multiple few-shot algorithmic, question-answering tasks, while also achieving lower next-token prediction loss on out-of-distribution evaluations. On held-out code, models with $N=2$ and $N=4$ match the no-sleep baseline's loss using $2.10\times$ and $2.39\times$ fewer tokens in-con…

Prior work has found that sleep, a process where the model performs $N$ recurrent forward passes to refine its representations of a chunk of context, can improve long-context reasoning (specifically, within SSM-attention hybrid models). We study whether this method also improves in-context adaptation on general, non-synthetic tasks for transformer language models. To this end, we pre-train language models up to 1.2B-parameters on up to 100B tokens with sleep mechanisms. Notably, longer sleep (i.e., using a larger number of recurrent forward passes $N$) enables the model to learn faster in-context on multiple few-shot algorithmic, question-answering tasks, while also achieving lower next-token prediction loss on out-of-distribution evaluations. item.title: ST-GNN-AAAS: Spatio-Temporal Graph Neural Networks for Anytime Automatic Algorithm Selection in the Traveling Salesman Problem
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF

Anytime Automatic Algorithm Selection (AAAS) aims to make solver choices under varying time budgets. The existing AAAS approaches largely rely on static instance characteristics and make limited use of temporal information revealed during solver execution. We propose ST-GNN-AAAS, a Spatio-Temporal Graph Neural Network framework for AAAS in the Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP). The framework represents evolving incumbent tours using time-varying node features, including distances from each node to its neighbors in the current tour, and combines these features with solver performance observations over a short history window. Given this short history, ST-GNN-AAAS predicts solver selections over a longer future horizon. We evaluate the method on a subset of diverse TSP benchmarks from NATIONAL, TNM, TSPLIB, and VLSI, releasing the corresponding solver execution data to support reproducibility. Our model achieves a selection accuracy of 76.59% and closes 46.05% of the average rank gap between the single best solver (SBS) and the virtual best solver (VBS).

item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF

Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) have demonstrated significant accuracy across various machine learning tasks. However, these networks suffer from a huge number of parameters and computations, which leads to time-consuming processes. Consequently, parameter pruning approaches have been proposed to compress DNNs and efficiently implement them. The main challenge in pruning is selecting the appropriate parameters for pruning without significantly damaging the accuracy. In this paper, we propose SPRUNN, an algorithmic pruning approach based on the structural proximity criterion for filter pruning in convolutional layers of deep neural networks. Structural Proximity (SP) calculates filter similarity by considering all filters and comparing each one with the others, effectively identifying less important filters for pruning in the convolutional layers. item.title: Rethinking Reasoning Effort Training in Large Language Models: On-Policy Distillation or Reinforcement Learning?
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF

Large language models have shown strong capabilities on complex tasks, yet how to control their reasoning effort remains a significant challenge for practical deployment. This paper provides a systematic investigation of reasoning-effort training, contrasting reinforcement learning (RL) with on-policy distillation (OPD). We find that compressing reasoning and separating effort tiers are governed by different signals. Length-penalized RL reliably compresses a single policy, reducing thinking on AIME25 by 70\% without accuracy loss, but collapses the tiers when they are trained jointly. Multi-teacher OPD separates them: across 33 benchmarks, low and medium use 58\% and 43\% fewer thinking tokens than high, while high improves on the reference policy by 3.1 points. We trace this difference to the training signal. A sequence-level reward cannot tell tier-specific behavior from shared behavior, whereas OPD supplies a tier-specific target at every visited state, including the decision to stop. Resource-efficient artificial intelligence has become increasingly important for…

Resource-efficient artificial intelligence has become increasingly important for sustainable agriculture, where timely disease forecasting must be achieved under computational and energy constraints. Early estimation of rice blast can enhance food security by optimizing crop management practices while reducing excessive pesticide use. However, existing frameworks often suffer from high computational overhead and limited capability to model the complex spectral-temporal dependencies present in heterogeneous meteorological and remote sensing data. item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF

Improvements in molecular property prediction are usually attributed to the model, although part of the gain may come from the molecular representation. New models are commonly benchmarked against a random forest (RF) trained on a molecular fingerprint, a comparison that changes the model and the representation at the same time. We separate the two contributions with a two-by-two factorial design in which the RF and a second model (CatBoost or the tabular foundation models TabPFN and TabFM) are each trained on a fingerprint and on RDKit descriptors, and each effect is tested with a paired scaffold bootstrap. Seven small MoleculeNet datasets (3 regression, 4 classification) are evaluated on the published split of a recent graph transformer (DGT), on 10 additional scaffold splits and on external datasets. For solubility and lipophilicity, the representation effect exceeds the model effect in every main factorial design, in all three evaluations. item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF

Collaborative edge computing supports AI agent applications by distributing execution across heterogeneous user-controlled devices with limited resources. This paper studies reliability-aware AI agent execution under node failures and wireless disruptions. These disruptions can make agent execution state unavailable or inconsistent, forcing recovery or recomputation that consumes the remaining deadline budget. Maintaining recoverable execution states can therefore improve request completion before deadlines. We formulate an online AI agent execution management problem that jointly selects resource allocations, state protection actions, and recovery targets to maximize the expected task success rate subject to resource, compatibility, and deadline constraints. We develop a world model that jointly captures evolving agent workflows and recoverable execution state under candidate management actions, accounting for node reliability, network conditions, and resource availability. item.title: RePrism: Joint Request and Representation Scheduling for LLM Agent Serving
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF

Agentic workflows often invoke large language models multiple times. When the dependencies are visible to the serving system, it can use them to schedule requests and cache reusable content, improving workflow execution efficiency. Prior work has largely focused on ordering requests or managing shared resources under a fixed caching scheme. A reusable prompt that specifies model behavior, however, can have multiple representations. We present RePrism, a serving system that jointly selects which ready request to serve and which eligible representation of its prompt to use. Its goal is to improve throughput and shorten session completion time (SCT). The scheduler ranks pairs of requests and representations by combining each pair's immediate value with an estimate of its future value based on the visible workflow. The resource manager allocates GPU memory to both LoRA adapters and cached key-value states. It also coordinates their admission and eviction as memory pressure changes. We compare RePrism with S-LoRA on a dynamic workload with an arrival rate of 1.8 sessions per second, and it achieves 1.37 times the request throughput and reduces P95 SCT by a factor of 4.10. item.title: RankServe: Rank-Aware CPU-GPU Scheduling for Memory-Constrained MoE Serving
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：MoE 模型专家池大、推理内存要求高；低秩压缩减小内存占用，但异构专家秩造成不等的存储、传输与执行成本。GPU 内存受限下，仅凭专家流行度与传输成本无法决定哪些专家最值得驻留。

方法：RankServe CPU-GPU 服务系统（固定专家秩的压缩 MoE 检查点）：按每位专家的秩与 token 负载，对 GPU 驻留与更便宜的非常驻路径（CPU 执行或权重传输后 GPU 执行）估值节省；按路由需求聚合估计节省、以每字节节省排序优先专家；从近期路由历史更新驻留、按当前 token 负载选择 miss 路径（允许不入缓存的临时 GPU 执行）；变秩运行时用分组矩阵乘执行异构因子、无需公共秩填充。

关键数字：vLLM 实现，3 个 MoE 模型 × 6 个服务系统、单 CPU-GPU 平台、batch 1-32 五档下，每模型几何平均 TTFT 加速 1.69-2.29x、TPOT 加速 1.71-2.48x（相对各配置最快基线）。

为什么值得看：压缩 MoE 驻留决策按"每字节节省"排序，CPU-GPU 协同服务落地。

item.title: RankCast: Phase-Aware Rank Balancing in MoE Serving
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.DC)　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题： 分离式 P/D 架构 + 专家并行（EP）的 MoE 服务中，每层都等待最忙 EP 秩，负载不均衡拖慢推理；且 prefill（计算密集，由最大 token 数决定）与 decode（内存密集，由最大活跃专家数决定）的瓶颈来源不同。

方法： RankCast 统一两阶段：每个 token 保留预测的 Top-p 专家，其余从 Top-L 候选中选取；prefill 用"每秩价格"引导灵活分配，decode 在最忙秩上关闭专家；在 SGLang 与 DeepEP 中实现，核与模型执行重叠、复用 DeepEP 通信通道。

关键数字： Qwen3-235B-A22B（EP=8）与 Qwen3.5-397B-A17B（EP=16）上移除最忙秩 75% 以上多余 prefill 负载；prefill 输入吞吐最高 +19%，decode 每输出 token 时间最高 -10%；质量损失低于 1 个百分点。

为什么值得看： 统一框架同时解决两阶段负载不均衡，生产框架内实测收益明确。

item.title: Provenance-Isolated Epistemic Quorums: Execution-Bound Evidence Certification and Plausible-World Safety Gating in Agentic Control Planes
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF

Agreement among large language models is not physical evidence for mutating production infrastructure. Because generative models share pretraining priors and conform to peer rationales during deliberation, voting ensembles correlate errors instead of providing independent fault tolerance; yet attaching rigid deterministic checks to unconstrained agent outputs paralyzes incident remediation. We present Provenance-Isolated Epistemic Quorums (PIEQ), an execution-bound certification layer that keeps every language model strictly outside the trusted computing base. PIEQ unifies assumption-based truth maintenance, physical provenance isolation, control-theoretic plausible-world safety shielding, and linearizable concurrency governance around three distinct obligations: certifying diagnostic preconditions from disjoint physical failure domains, gating candidate mutations across all unrefuted fault worlds while falling back to read-only diagnostic probes under ambiguity, and binding admission certificates to target execution through snapshot barriers, revision checks, authorization freshness, trusted temporal-precondition policies, and capability-tiered enforcement. item.title: PhysRF-WorldJEPA: Transforming Heterogeneous Large Language Models into Manifold-Decoupled Millimeter-Wave Radar World Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF

Adapting Large Language Models (LLMs) to millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar enables privacy-preserving, all-weather physical scene understanding across darkness, smoke, and walls. However, standard instruction tuning treats continuous radar streams as static text-like tokens, causing near-random global radar-to-text retrieval and severe physical drift under sensor blackouts. Conversely, coupling pairwise contrastive losses (e.g., SigLIP) directly into the shared backbone improves retrieval but injects $O(B^2)$ repulsive gradients that fracture continuous coordinate manifolds ($R^2 < 0$). We present PhysRF-WorldJEPA, a manifold-decoupled Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) that separates continuous electromagnetic state prediction from cross-modal language alignment. item.title: Parallel Memory Management in Goose, C++, and Rust: An Experimental Study of Allocation, Reclamation, and Scaling
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF

Compiler-managed memory can reduce allocation and reclamation overhead, but its behavior under parallel workloads remains insufficiently characterized. This study evaluates Goose v2026.3 against C++ and Rust implementations, including tree variants with individually allocated nodes and contiguous arenas. We benchmarked worker-local dynamic arrays and binary trees using multiple workers on a workstation with four physical cores and eight logical CPUs. Repeated tree experiments included five construction, traversal, and reclamation rounds. Each main experimental configuration was measured in 15 independent process runs. We measured whole-process execution time, release-operation intervals, and memory usage at synchronized checkpoints. We also examined strong and weak scaling. For depth-20 trees with eight workers, Goose achieved 5.62% and 10.95% lower median execution times than the C++ and Rust arenas, respectively. Its additional process RSS at the LIVE checkpoint was comparable to the arenas and substantially lower than that of individually allocated trees, but its virtual memory size was much larger. item.title: Pando: Noise-Coupled Parallel Draft Trees for Efficient Edge Speculative Decoding
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：自回归解码每 token 一次前向、每次重载全模型，边缘 LLM 推理受内存带宽限制；并行草稿器（DFlash/DSpark）一次前向提议整块草稿 token，但草稿链长度被训练块大小封顶，大部分验证算力预算闲置。

方法：Pando 在并行草稿器之上构建动态草稿树、移除长度上限；噪声耦合剪枝在草稿前先抽取目标模型的采样噪声、在该噪声下对候选分支排序，从而保留目标实际会采样的分支；无损、无需重训或额外模型 pass。

关键数字：Qwen3-8B 上接受长度最高 +8.4%；代表性边缘设备上 16 节点 Pando 树较 AR 解码 5.3x 加速、4.2x 能耗降低；较 DSpark 发布链快 25%，较 EAGLE-3 树快 27%、能耗效率高 72%；建模的所有边缘设备上最佳配置仍保持内存受限。

为什么值得看：把并行草稿器的验证算力预算用满的草稿树方案，边缘投机解码新上限。

item.title: PFedHASNet: A Personalized Federated Hybrid Analog-Spike Network for Multi-Subject Motor Imagery EEG Decoding
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF

Motor imagery electroencephalography (MI-EEG) data are often collected and stored separately across subjects or institutions, and EEG acquisition and annotation remain costly. Training models solely on individual subject data limits the use of information from other subjects, whereas centralizing raw EEG recordings raises privacy and data governance concerns. Federated learning (FL) enables collaborative model training across distributed clients without sharing raw EEG data, providing a practical approach to leveraging information from multiple subjects. Accordingly, we propose PFedHASNet, a personalized federated hybrid analog-spike network for MI-EEG decoding. The shared encoder integrates continuous-valued temporal features, leaky integrate-and-fire (LIF) spike responses, and channel-wise log-variance statistics through learnable fusion weights. Client-private residual adapters and classifiers perform subject-specific feature refinement and personalized prediction, respectively. Experiments on held-out trials from participating subjects across four public MI-EEG datasets show that PFedHASNet achieves the highest mean client macro-F1 among 18 model configurations in cross-model c…

item.title: OrangeTree: A Linear and Tree-based Time Series Forecasting Model Supporting Multiple Input and Output Lengths
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF

Time series forecasting (TSF) models suffer from a critical rigidity: the inability to handle Multiple Input and Output Lengths (MIOL) within a single architecture. Current workarounds, such as padding or autoregression, often incur computational redundancy or suffer from error accumulation. We propose OrangeTree, a linear and tree-based architecture that decouples model parameters from sequence lengths. It employs a Segment Tree Encoder and an Inverse Tree Decoder to translate multi-length input history into multi-length output predictions within a unified framework. Crucially, a Range Weighter and a Feature Fuser bridge these components, dynamically selecting and fusing relevant ranges into optimal contexts for forecasting. Experiments on six benchmarks confirm OrangeTree achieves the SOTA performance. In MIOL settings, it matches the accuracy of length-fixed models without substantial accuracy degradation or a substantial increase in inference latency typical of heuristic methods. Code is available at https://github.com/Tang-Yiqi/OrangeTree.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: OpenWoud: Vendor-Unlocked Scalable Adaptive Random Forest Accelerator
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：在线机器学习在演化数据流上做实时决策，自适应随机森林（ARF）是 SOTA 模型且天然暴露并行性、适合硬件加速；但既有 FPGA 加速器厂商锁定、依赖资源饥渴的浮点（FP）算术，限制可扩展性与可移植性。

方法：OpenWoud 厂商无关 ARF 框架：用灵活定点（FxP）算术库替换 FP 算子；训练与漂移检测采用完全透明的手调度数据流；支持细粒度时间/面积权衡与跨平台可预测行为。

关键数字：合成与真实数据集上较先前 FPGA 加速器保持或提升精度（最高 +12.89%），资源利用率减半；较 GPU 为 0.5-1.5x 速度、较 FPGA 基线 0.2-0.5x（后者基于理想化仿真）；真正逐样本推理，而 GPU 需要批量插入。

为什么值得看：FPGA 上厂商无关的在线随机森林加速，定点替代浮点 + 逐样本流式。

item.title: One Token, Many Lessons: Sliding-Window Attention within Gated Delta Networks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题： 从测试时回归（TTR）视角看线性注意力，状态学习效果不仅取决于更新规则，还取决于用于状态更新的键值学习对如何构建——现有工作大多忽略后者。

方法： 提出 Sliding-Window Gated DeltaNet（SWGDN），用滑窗注意力替代 Delta-Rule 线性注意力中的短卷积，对投影后的 Q/K/V 做内容相关的局部聚合，使连续更新的键值对更相似、帮助循环状态强化已学关联；可嵌入任意 Delta-Rule 架构而不改状态更新方程与分块并行算法。

关键数字： 无量化收益数字；实验在多个 benchmark 上均优于原始 Delta-Rule 基线（GDN2 与 KDA 两个变体均验证）。

为什么值得看： 一个可插拔的局部混合策略，零架构改动即可提升线性注意力在长序列建模中的表现。

item.title: On the Design of a Slow Control Interlock System for the European GateMate FPGA
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF

Slow Control Systems (SCSs) are essential for the monitoring, configuration, and protection of distributed safety-critical systems in scientific, industrial, and medical applications. Although software-based SCS architectures offer flexibility and scalability, they suffer from software aging and non-deterministic latencies, which limit long-term reliability and timely reaction to critical errors, often requiring additional hardware interlock systems. This paper presents an FPGA-centric lightweight Slow Control Interlock System (SCIS) designed to achieve deterministic ultra-low-latency reaction times in long-running dependable systems. System parameters are acquired and fused at runtime in a Supervisory Monitor Unit (SMU), enabling real-time fault condition classification and prioritization through configurable priority rules and triggering kill-switch actions with microsecond-scale latency. The proposed SMU has been described in VHDL as vendor-agnostic architecture, and assessed on the 28-nm GateMate M1A1 FPGA, using the open-source OSS-CAD-Suite toolchain. Experimental results show that the SMU architecture utilizes only 37,6% of LUTs, 9,4% of FFs, and 35,9% of BRAM. Furthermore, …

item.title: Norn: Context-Length-Aware Optimization of Weight and KV Cache Placement for Offloaded LLM Inference
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：把权重与 KV 缓存 offload 到 host 内存使 LLM 可跑在单张内存受限 GPU；解码中 KV 不断增长，GPU 内存需求与传输/注意力成本随之变化，但现有方法用静态计算分配与放置，无法适应。

方法：Norn 上下文长度感知 offload 推理：基于离线 profiling 在子层级别协同优化计算分配与放置，预计算多个执行计划及其切换点；解码中随上下文长度增长切换计划，无需预知输出长度即可重叠计算与数据传输；prefill 用 operator-major chunked prefill 避免重复权重传输并自动选择 chunk 大小。

关键数字：Qwen3-14B 与 Qwen3-32B 在两个单 GPU 系统上，端到端延迟较 Pipelined Sharding 最高提速 16.8x，较已知输入输出长度的 oracle 变体提速 4.2x。

为什么值得看：offload 推理随上下文动态换执行计划，单 GPU 大模型推理显著加速。

item.title: Network-Guided Automated Synthesis of MAC Units for Neural Network Inference
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：神经推理加速器中乘累加（MAC）数据路径占大部分电路面积与关键路径延迟，算子级数值格式同时决定硬件开销与量化误差；但硬件成本与端到端网络精度之间不存在直接映射。

方法：NAMSI 自动化网络感知 MAC 综合框架：用格式分布表示（FD）刻画异构数据格式；拓扑感知的精度与硬件成本建模（TaH）以实际综合后面积-延迟积（ADP）校准，联合估计耦合的全网络精度与电路成本；可逆格搜索（RLS）可解地导航指数级设计空间。

关键数字：ImageNet-1K 五个网络、后训练量化（PTQ）下，较 FP32 的综合后 MAC ADP 降 54.2%-60.4%，同时保留至少 99% 全精度 Top-1 精度；硬件效率与精度保持均超基线方法。

为什么值得看：把数值格式-电路成本-网络精度三方联动建模，自动搜索 MAC 数据路径。

item.title: Native Block-Quantized Matrix Multiplication and Explicit K/V Residency with Dual-View Access for LLM Inference on RISC-V Vector Processors
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：LLM 推理中部分关键执行状态跨多条指令持续存在，难以在 RVV（RISC-V 向量扩展）以单条操作语义表达与利用。

方法：按数据状态生命周期定义特化边界，提出 Quantized Block Streams（QBS）与 Attention/KV Context（AKV），同时保持 RVV 可编程性：QBS 把原生块格式处理、块遍历、整数计算与有序 FP32 累加统一为单一执行流；AKV 维持本地 K/V 驻留、按计算方向提供对齐的操作数视图，注意力算术仍留在 RVV。

关键数字：cycle-accurate RTL 评估中，QBS 对投影计算与矩阵乘的几何平均加速为 35.68x 与 51.34x；AKV 解码注意力较 Tiled RVV 加速 1.45x；总面积 +12.65%；投影负载上每面积吞吐与能效分别提升 46.63x 与 19.78x；适用于多种块量化格式与不同注意力组织的模型。

为什么值得看：RISC-V 向量处理器上 LLM 推理的原生块量化 + 显式 K/V 驻留完整方案。

item.title: NEVA: Natural-Language Co-Evolution and Validation of Microarchitectures
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.AR)　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题： LLM 引导的微架构设计探索现有方法直接演化 C++ 模拟器代码，迫使 LLM 推理实现细节而非架构机制本身，如何让演化发生在设计层？

方法： NEVA 从已发表研究中抽取架构概念进入结构化知识库，再引导自然语言架构规范（NLS）的协同进化；利用诊断反馈协调微架构组件，在硬件约束下验证候选设计。

关键数字： Claude Opus 5.5 下发现的设计比 Pythia-Mockingjay 基线最高 +4.8% 保留单核性能；EvoX 设计在全/受限内存带宽下分别 +3.4%/+1.5%；40 个候选评估 2.2 天、LLM 花费约 $320（API 列表价）。

为什么值得看： 把设计探索从代码层提升到架构概念层，成本可控、可复现。

item.title: Multi Agent Reinforcement Learning enhanced Federated Learning for Predicting Remaining Useful Lifetime
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF

Remaining useful life (RUL) prediction is central to Prognostics and Health Management (PHM). The growth of industrial IoT has unlocked large multivariate sensor streams and enabled deep models - especially Transformers - for long-horizon sequence learning. However, transformers are parameter-heavy and data-hungry, while operational datasets are often siloed and privacy-sensitive. Federated Learning (FL) addresses this by training across clients without raw data sharing, but in practice many clients connect over lossy wireless links where UDP is preferred for low latency, making model exchange vulnerable to packet drops. We present a cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning (MARL) framework that adapts FL to lossy channels by selecting per-client layer subsets to transmit and capping retransmissions. This framework is trained with QMIX value-function factorization for scalability. We instantiate the approach with a Graph Convolution Position-Aware Transformer (GCPATr) for RUL forecasting. On the CMAPSS dataset, our MARL-enhanced FL (RL-FL) consistently improves mean square error over standard FL, with the largest gains at high packet loss (e.g., up to 18% improvement on FD003…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: ModelLess: A Serverless System for Multi-Tier LLM Inference on Shared GPUs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：LLM 推理平台按产品分 GPU 提供在线、异步、批处理与 rollout 服务，服务爆发间隙卡片闲置而其他工作等待。

方法：ModelLess 无服务器系统：用户声明模型服务、平台持有实例；空闲服务缩到零——实例休眠且权重留在 host 内存（释放约 1s、唤醒约 4s，GLM-5.2 TP8，对比冷启动超 4 分钟），按持有 GPU 时间计费；空闲实例释放的 GPU 借给低层；每层（在线/作业/flex）定义被抢占时可丢失的内容，抢占协议先关准入再释放内存、先持久重入队再中止请求、失败即关闭（fail closed）。

关键数字：回放 1,100 张 H20 卡一周 trace，约 38% GPU 时间（417 等效 GPU）可在粗延迟目标 + 单固定空闲阈值下借出（理想上界，仅在恢复秒级时成立；240s 冷启动时仅余 8%）；单节点单策略 4 小时运行显示，暂停比中止-重入队每持有 GPU 样本多借出 22% token，中位在线延迟相同。

为什么值得看：GPU 资源池化的无服务器 LLM 推理，借出收益量级与边界条件清晰。

item.title: Measuring Layer-wise Intrinsic Dimensionality of FFNs in LLMs via PCA
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：现代 LLM 各层 FFN 中间宽度相同（Transformer 惯例），但机制研究显示不同深度做不同工作——容量需求是否非均匀？固定参数预算能否分配得比均匀更聪明？

方法：对每个 FFN 下投影输入做 PCA，把本征维度定义为重建激活到固定余弦相似度所需的最少主成分数；扫描 58 个开源 LLM（14 个家族、70M-72B 参数）；并用 PCA 引导宽度剪枝（知识蒸馏学生、匹配参数预算）直接检验该信号的结构意义。

关键数字：发现"中厚"剖面——中间层本征维度高于边缘层，对标定语料稳健（中英文皆然），后训练微调大体保留；PCA 引导分配较均匀宽度在 Qwen3-8B +2.3、Qwen2.5-3B +2.5 点，低离散教师差距更小（Gemma-3-4B +0.9、LLaMA-3-8B +0.5）；差距大小随教师层间维度不均匀度（σ99）变化；代码开源。

为什么值得看：大规模层间本征维度测量，直接用于非均匀宽度分配。

item.title: Mayfly: Lifecycle-Aware High-Bandwidth Flash for Recursive Self-Improvement
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：递归自我改进（RSI）让 LLM 通过提议与评估候选变体改进 agent 系统；高并发下即使就绪 session 的 KV 也超出 GPU HBM，offload 到 host 内存/SSD 增加容量却让 session 等待 HBM 空间；高带宽闪存（HBF）可原地服务溢出，但过多读取延长解码、重复写入消耗闪存寿命。

方法：关键洞察是就绪 KV 的读取位置应跟随突发与衰减：溢出 HBM 时按每步带宽上限从 HBF 原位读取，衰减释放空间后回到 HBM。Mayfly 生命周期引导管理：限制溢出期每步 HBF 读取、session 结束归还 KV、保留每个被驱逐块的闪存备份避免状态转换重写、转发 session 结束信号避免 GC 复制死 KV。

关键数字：128 session/代 × 4 个 HBF 站点时，比把 KV 停放在 HBF 快 34%、比 HBM 满时总从 HBF 读快 23%；并发增长收益扩大，256 session × 8 站点达 55%；每块保留一份闪存副本 + 按声明结束时间修剪避免写放大。

为什么值得看：RSI 场景 KV 生命周期管理的系统方案，延迟与闪存寿命兼得。

item.title: Machine-Learning-Assisted Hybrid Cooling of a Raspberry Pi 5
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF

Thermal management is a critical challenge in compact computing platforms operating under sustained high computational loads. Elevated processor temperatures can lead to thermal throttling, degraded performance, and reduced reliability. This study develops and experimentally evaluates a smart hybrid heat sink that integrates passive thermal energy storage with active cooling for sustained device operation. The proposed design comprises an aluminum cavity containing paraffin wax as a phase change material (PCM) embedded within a copper foam and integrated with an adaptively controlled fan. Fan operation is guided by a Random Forest regression model trained on experimentally measured CPU temperature data to predict future CPU temperatures. The predicted temperature is then used to support the adaptive fan control strategy. The heat sink is mounted directly on the CPU of a Raspberry Pi 5 and experimentally evaluated under an extreme CPU workload of approximately 99 percent CPU utilization. The performance of the proposed hybrid system is compared against two benchmark scenarios: passive cooling using PCM embedded in copper foam and a commercial Raspberry Pi 5 active cooler. item.title: MXFP4 for LLM Inference: Complementary Post-Training Quantization Techniques and Their Interactions
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：microscaling 数值格式（16/32 元素共享缩放因子）支持激进低精度量化，但精度取决于格式与旋转、PTQ 算法、缩放选择的交互；MXFP4 与 NVFP4 的受益技术是否互通未知。

方法：对 6 个 LLM × 3 种 micros caling 格式（MXFP6/MXFP4/NVFP4），系统变化 Hadamard 旋转粒度、PTQ 算法与缩放选择策略；提出 Midmax 免校准缩放选择，缓解 2 的幂块缩放中的裁剪误差。

关键数字：有效量化配方与格式相关——MXFP4 显著受益于旋转与纠错 PTQ，NVFP4 获益较少（其细粒度缩放已捕获更多块内变化）；MXFP6 激活 + MXFP4 权重恢复 4-bit 损失精度，Llama-3.1-8B 匹配或超 BF16 基线；逐张量宏观缩放不改善 MXFP4 平均精度。

为什么值得看：格式-算法交互的系统研究，给出 MXFP4 精度落地的实操配方。

item.title: MOSAIC: Memory-Organized Search with Anti-Imitation Crossover for Training-Free Microarchitecture Optimization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：LLM 可生成缓存替换策略，核心挑战是保留搜索外工作负载的性能；已发表搜索方法改编出的代码与既有策略高度相似（余弦相似度 0.78-0.84），留出工作负载 IPC 损失 1.0-2.4%。

方法：MOSAIC 搜索控制器，不更新模型权重：存储先前评估的简明经验而非反复复制高分代码；改进停滞时选出两个代码嵌入差异大的高分策略，请模型组合其机制；用新颖性提示与模型轮换支持搜索，受控记忆编辑测试经验对后续提案的影响。

关键数字：主搜索工作负载峰值命中率 51.1%、干预研究留出均值 47.9%，移除交叉分别降 7.8 与 21.8 个百分点；更宽 IPC 比较中留出差距最小（0.31%）、留出 IPC 最高；迁移到数据预取较 LRU 平均提速 4.8%；语料含 10,687 个生成策略。

为什么值得看：免训练微架构搜索的控制器设计，经验记忆 + 反模仿交叉显著提升留出性能。

item.title: Learning Compact State Abstractions for LLM Agents
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF

LLM agents commonly use the full interaction history as a proxy for state, retaining all past observations and actions regardless of whether they remain relevant. We instead ask what information an agent actually needs to carry forward. We define agent state as a compact abstraction of interaction history that preserves the competence of a fixed reference agent, with the minimal such abstraction as the ideal. Because matching the reference agent's behavior is unnecessarily restrictive and difficult for black-box policies, we define sufficiency through task performance rather than behavior matching. We represent state abstractions as deterministic recursive programs and search over them using an LLM-guided genetic algorithm. Across ALFWorld and ScienceWorld, the learned abstractions preserve near-reference task success while reducing mean policy input by up to 71% and 57%, respectively. The resulting programs are directly inspectable, providing an explicit account of what information is retained, updated, and discarded during interaction.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Latent Merger: Latent-Space Composition of Hypernetwork-Generated LoRAs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF

Recent work proposes hypernetworks that convert a document into a low-rank parameter update (LoRA) in a single forward pass, enabling fast injection of new knowledge into a frozen LLM. However, storing separate LoRA adapters for each document can be unsustainable in streaming settings. In this paper, we study the problem of composing hypernetwork-generated LoRAs using two representative systems, Doc-to-LoRA and SHINE. We show that hypernetwork-generated LoRAs have a geometry sharply different from directly fine-tuned LoRAs. They exhibit greater spectral concentration and stronger cross-document alignment than next-token prediction and QA fine-tuned adapters, which are diffuse and nearly orthogonal across documents. Guided by this observation, we propose latent-space LoRA merging. We compose the intermediate hypernetwork latents and then decode the merged latent through the frozen LoRA-generation head. We show that latent-space merging techniques consistently improve over weight-space and factor-space baselines while preserving a single fixed-rank adapter. These results support latent-space composition as a promising mechanism for combining hypernetwork-generated LoRAs under a fixed…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: LIBRA: Runtime Co-Tuning of Batch Size and Parallelism for Time-Efficient LLM Training
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：LLM 训练需同时选批量大小与并行配置，现有系统分开决策——并行度只调吞吐、批量大小只调收敛，二者单独都不决定训练效率。

方法：LIBRA 轻量运行时框架，把吞吐与收敛视为两个噪声目标，用并行噪声期望超体积改进（qNEHVI）搜索联合空间；分层剪枝先用系统级性能估计剔除不可行/低吞吐并行配置，再用关键批量大小感知的收敛监控收窄 batch 候选；采集引导并行评估（AGPE）按采集值顺序跨 GPU 组并发评估幸存候选。

关键数字：最多 256 GPU 集群上较 SOTA 方法平均收敛时间（time-to-convergence）降 31.1%；运行时调优仅占总训练时间 0.3-3.5%。

为什么值得看：吞吐与收敛联合优化的运行时方案，调优开销可忽略。

item.title: LEGOSpec: A Composable and Efficient Framework for Speculative Draft Design and Training
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：投机解码用轻量草稿加速 LLM 生成，但现有方法在不同训练配置下评估完整方案，组件效果、交互与组合收益不明。

方法：LEGOSpec 可组合框架，把草稿模型分解为 Context、Backbone、Proposal、Objective 四类组件并共享统一训练设施；在匹配训练条件下系统变化组件、评估选定组合以隔离效果与交互；三个发现（负载偏好不同骨干、提案需平衡接受率与延迟、训练目标需局部匹配 token 分布）指导负载感知配置与 DFlux（卷积 SWA-GQA 混合骨干 + Residual Corrector + 分层监督）。

关键数字：Qwen 与 Gemma 上 DFlux 接受长度较最强基线常规基准最高 +13.7%、长上下文 +34.7%；训练吞吐最高 +79%、离线监督准备较 SpecForge 加速最高 3.11x。

为什么值得看：首次系统解耦投机草稿设计空间，给出负载感知配置指导。

item.title: LATEC: Learned Axial TEnsor Compression for High-Dimensional Scientific Data
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：科学模拟数据规模增长使存储与分析成为瓶颈——能否用学习式编解码器做满足逐点误差界的压缩，并跨张量维度通用？

方法：提出 LATEC，基于 GNN 的维度无关学习预测器的误差有界编解码器；在合成 2-D 与 4-D 场上预训练，在 13 个 3-D 至 5-D 科学场上评估（含/不含领域微调）。

关键数字：与 SZ3 竞争一致，平均改进 18.1%，跨域一致性优于其他压缩器；保留逐点误差保证。

为什么值得看：一个共享学习预测器即可充当跨张量维度的单一误差有界编解码器，媲美专用压缩器且不丢误差界。

item.title: KiRA: Kronecker Input-Gated Rank Adaptation for Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of Pretrained Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题： PEFT 的低秩更新存在秩天花板（远低于全量微调且对所有输入相同），输入自适应变体仍受低秩瓶颈约束，且无法预知任务是否受益于输入条件化。

方法： KiRA 用 Kronecker 乘积 ΔW = A ⊗ M(x)（A 为冻结随机矩阵）突破秩上限——秩在乘积下相乘，A 将 M(x) 的秩放大 p 倍而不增加可训练参数；输入门 g(x) 按离散步长调整每输入的更新秩，部署时无需条件化则折叠入门中。

关键数字： 6 个医学影像与语言 benchmark 上均分最高；比低秩适配少 8.7–9.7 倍可训练参数；预训练准则在全部 6 个任务上与实测输入条件化收益一致。

为什么值得看： 只需数百个标注输入即可在训练前预测条件化的价值，避免盲目采用输入自适应。

item.title: Joule is FLOP: Optimizing Tensor-Core Kernels Beyond Latency Hiding at the GPU Power Wall
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：张量核 kernel 平均板级功耗贴近 GPU 功率上限时，运行时间≈每次调用能耗÷功率上限——被计算隐藏的数据搬运仍耗能，能否把能耗-频率耦合纳入 kernel 设计与调度？

方法：提出 Joule 框架：成本模型结合硬件事件计数、物理数据通路能耗与跨域非线性电压缩放，求解功率上限下的持续频率与运行时间；结合跨内存层级与 die 的数据搬运下界得功耗感知光速（PSoL）；指导 B200 上充分利用张量内存的宽 tile kernel 与功耗感知的空间/时间 tile 调度。

关键数字：B200 上平均能耗预测误差 0.69%；60 种稠密层形状上 GEMM 相对穷举 cuBLAS 在 B200、H100 NVL、RTX PRO 6000 分别几何平均提速 4.94%、6.64%、2.12%；八卡 B200 融合 Mega-MoE 相对上游 DeepGEMM 提升 2.60%–5.17%。

为什么值得看：把「被延迟隐藏的能耗」变成可建模、可优化的一等公民，为功耗墙下的 GPU kernel 优化提供新度量与新思路。

item.title: Joint Classification and Generation on Tabular Data: an Empirical Study
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF

Many applications of machine learning on tabular data need both a classifier and a generator of realistic records. The default is to train two separate models, whereas a single joint model promises both from one set of weights. Several families of tabular deep learning models can be turned into such a joint model, which raises the question of which joint model is preferable at which computational budget. In this empirical study, we introduce and compare joint models based on four state-of-the-art tabular data modeling families (energy-based models, probabilistic circuits, tabular foundation models and tabular diffusion models) against measured FLOPs and wall-clock time, on 29 classification datasets. Methods are evaluated based on two defined aggregate scores that take into account different aspects of prediction and generation. We then also compare these joint models with every pair of a separate classifier and generator at different computational budgets, to see when a joint model may be a defendible choice against the regular practice of keeping a separate classifier and generator. We find that the best joint model is a probabilistic circuit at the smallest budgets and, beyond t…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Integral DeltaNet: Improved Linear Attention with Adaptive Memory Integration
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：线性注意力把历史压进固定大小状态，内存碰撞损害长上下文理解；DeltaNet 的 delta 规则与门控虽缓解碰撞，却可能丢弃对未来预测有用的信息——如何兼顾？

方法：提出 Integral DeltaNet，维护两个互补循环状态：快速更新的 delta 状态捕捉当前键值关联，积分状态保留 delta 状态的加权历史；读出时自适应组合两者以访问不同时间尺度的信息；并推导分块并行公式实现硬件高效训练。

关键数字：340M 与 1.3B 参数模型分别在 15B 与 100B FineWeb-Edu token 上从零训练；相对强循环基线在语言建模、常识推理、真实与合成检索、长上下文理解与长度外推上整体更优；同时比较训练吞吐、激活内存与解码时延/内存。

为什么值得看：双状态设计直击线性注意力「压缩即丢失」的根本矛盾，长上下文场景有实测收益。
item.content:encoded:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：线性注意力把历史压进固定大小状态，内存碰撞损害长上下文理解；DeltaNet 的 delta 规则与门控虽缓解碰撞，却可能丢弃对未来预测有用的信息——如何兼顾？

方法：提出 Integral DeltaNet，维护两个互补循环状态：快速更新的 delta 状态捕捉当前键值关联，积分状态保留 delta 状态的加权历史；读出时自适应组合两者以访问不同时间尺度的信息；并推导分块并行公式实现硬件高效训练。

关键数字：340M 与 1.3B 参数模型分别在 15B 与 100B FineWeb-Edu token 上从零训练；相对强循环基线在语言建模、常识推理、真实与合成检索、长上下文理解与长度外推上整体更优；同时比较训练吞吐、激活内存与解码时延/内存。

为什么值得看：双状态设计直击线性注意力「压缩即丢失」的根本矛盾，长上下文场景有实测收益。

item.title: InducedTFMs: A Family of Sub-Quadratic Tabular Foundation Models Using Induced Attention
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF

Tabular foundation models (TFMs) have emerged as a serious competitor to gradient-boosted trees, predicting on a new table in a single forward pass by in-context learning. However, their attention is quadratic in the number of samples and features, which caps pretraining at small synthetic tables and forces inference on large ones to rely on chunking or subsampling. Row-compression models reduce the feature-wise cost, but only by discarding the cell-level representation, and remain quadratic in the number of samples. We introduce InducedTFM, which replaces both attention stages of a bidimensional TFM with the induced attention of the Set Transformer, preserving cell-level representations while making its cost linear in both samples and features. Under a training budget matched to a full-attention TabICLv2 reimplementation, InducedTFM matches its accuracy on TabArena and on a benchmark of larger datasets, and clearly outperforms a kernel linear-attention baseline of the same asymptotic cost. It overtakes TabICLv2 in inference time on narrow tables, reaching a 30x speed-up at 640K rows, although row compression remains preferable on wide tables.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: High-Performance Algorithms for Computing the V-BLAST Permutation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF

We propose two novel and efficient algorithms for computing a column permutation called V-BLAST or an approximation of it. The V-BLAST column permutation is used in a QR factorization that is part of an integer/discrete least-squares solver. The overall solver is part of the receiver in advanced communication systems that transmit multiple symbols simultaneously. Two classes of efficient algorithms for computing the exact V-BLAST permutation have been proposed in the literature. The first, based on a sequence of Givens rotations, is unfortunately highly sequential. The other, based on a sequence of downdating operations on a pseudo-inverse, has a shorter critical path, but is unlikely to be numerically stable. The new algorithms that we propose are inspired by the similarity between V-BLAST and rank-revealing QR factorizations. Our first algorithm uses Householder reflections, is numerically stable, and has a short critical path. It is unable, however, to efficiently exploit cache memories. We rectify this with a randomized algorithm that computes an approximation to the V-BLAST permutation and has a short critical path and can effectively exploit cache memories. We prove approxima…

item.title: HiCal: Offline Calibration for Hierarchical Scale Encoding in Accurate HiF4 Quantization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：HiFloat4（HiF4）的层次化缩放编码（全局 E6M2 尺度 + 两级二进制尺度扩展）默认舍入规则与固定扩展阈值未充分贴合张量统计特征——能否离线校准改进量化精度？

方法：提出 HiCal，离线校准三个尺度的编码决策：为 Level-1 E6M2 尺度引入校准舍入偏置，按局部组幅值经验分布优化 Level-2/3 的尺度扩展阈值；校准参数离线确定、推理期固定，层次化编码仍按局部值自适应，无需逐块多候选尺度搜索。

关键数字：五种合成与真实激活分布上量化 MSE 相对原 HiF4 降 9.91%–23.50%，Qwen3-8B 真实激活降 13.00%；六个基准端到端平均分在 Qwen3-8B 与 Qwen3-30B-A3B 上分别提升 0.91 与 1.25 个百分点。

为什么值得看：不动推理期开销、只改离线校准就把 HiF4 精度明显抬高，是低比特 LLM 量化的低成本改进路径。

item.title: Generalized Tensor Parallelism: Powering Trillion-Parameter LLM Training at 10+ EFLOP/s
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：万亿参数 LLM 预训练受内存与算力双重约束，现有并行方案要么牺牲单卡内存要么牺牲吞吐——能否统一并超越？

方法：提出广义张量并行（GTP）：证明数据、张量、序列、上下文并行与 FSDP 五种常用并行都是 GTP 的特例——每层参数与激活可分区、用前 all-gather 重物化；GTP 按 GEMM 而非整个 Transformer 块调度 all-gather，够早隐藏通信、够晚控制内存。

关键数字：内部 2T 参数 MoE 模型在 12,288 张 GB300 上达 13.0 model EFLOP/s、弱扩展效率 98%，512 GPU 上跑 1M token 序列；256–1024 GPU 上三种 MoE 模型吞吐为 Megatron-FSDP 的 1.05–1.55×，DeepSeek-V4-Pro 代理模型上为调优 3D 并行配方的 1.27–1.31×。

为什么值得看：统一了主流并行框架并给出 10+ EFLOP/s 的实测，万亿参数训练的并行度调度有了新范式。

item.title: Gated Concept Adapters: Layer-Wise Concept Bottlenecks for Auditable Text Understanding
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF

Human-facing text understanding systems are used to infer affect, moderate harmful content, and support socially sensitive decisions. However, Transformer predictions are difficult to audit because they are produced from high-dimensional hidden states that do not provide a compact, inspectable interface for human analysis or intervention. We introduce Gated Concept Adapters (GCA), a layer-wise concept bottleneck framework that attaches gated, low-dimensional concept-producing readout adapters to selected outputs of pretrained Transformers. Token representations are mapped into concept activations, filtered by learned gates, pooled into layer-level summaries, and exposed to the prediction head as a concept-mediated interface. The dimensions can be inspected through usage statistics, signature n-grams, post-hoc concept names, and targeted concept interventions. We evaluate GCA on fine-grained emotion classification, toxicity detection, topic classification, and a controlled verb-cloze stress test. In the affective and safety-relevant classification settings, GCA learns comparatively low-redundancy and intervention-sensitive concept representations while retaining useful predictive pe…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: FlowersBench: A FluidFlower-Inspired Dataset for Benchmarking Carbon Storage Surrogates Across Geological Structures
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF

Machine learning surrogates are emerging as a computationally efficient tool for…

Machine learning surrogates are emerging as a computationally efficient tool for uncertainty quantification in geological carbon storage (GCS). Geological structure constitutes a major source of uncertainty; however, existing benchmark simulation datasets predominantly vary petrophysical and operational parameters within a fixed geological setting. Generalisation to unseen geological structures therefore remains largely unexplored. We introduce FlowersBench, a benchmark dataset of 5,000 two-dimensional, reservoir-scale CO$_2$ storage simulations across 244 structural geometries. The geometries are sampled from an in-house structural generator inspired by the FluidFlower experiments and Case B of the 11th Society of Petroleum Engineers Comparative Solution Project (SPE11B). Each simulation is run with Open Porous Media (OPM) Flow over a 50-year injection period and a 500-year post-injection monitoring period. Test geometries are withheld from training to assess generalisation to unseen structural geometries. Two additional subsets support evaluation under structural shift. The first extends the parameter ranges of the structural generator beyond those used for training, and the seco…

item.title: FlashQLA: Efficient Context Parallelism for Gated DeltaNet
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：Gated DeltaNet（GDN）通过循环状态更新获得线性复杂度，但块间顺序依赖限制了并行度，尤其长上下文小 batch 场景——如何提升其上下文并行效率？

方法：提出 FlashQLA：衰减感知准备降低边界状态预处理开销；Dual CP 跨并行层级共享 summary 计算把序列并行扩展到多 GPU；负载自适应 Auto CP 与 CP 感知 kernel 协同设计进一步提升执行效率。

关键数字：单 GPU 上相对 Flash Linear Attention（FLA）前向加速 1.7–3.1×、后向最高 4.4×；八 GPU、上下文最长 1M token 时 Dual CP 相对 FLA KCP 前向最高 4.8×、前向后向合计 4.4×。

为什么值得看：针对 GDN 类线性注意力长上下文训练/推理的并行瓶颈给出了系统化解法，数字直接可用于选型。

item.title: Fix How It Acts, Not How It Thinks: Surgical Fine-Tuning of Frontier LLMs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：开源权重 LLM 常「会做但做错」——不是推理失败，而是长轨迹上的小失误（重复已失败的步骤、需求未满足就宣告完成）。如何做外科手术式的权重更新而不干扰推理？

方法：提出 merge-aware fine-tuning：标准 LoRA 只在导出时舍入合并权重，损失从未见过舍入后权重；新方法每一步训练都先把基础权重与 adapter 更新之和舍入到发布格式（保留厂商量化尺度）再算损失，前向与推理引擎数值一致、梯度直穿舍入，只优化行为、让推理贴近基础模型。

关键数字：BF16 发布版中位权重变化仅单次舍入步的 1.5%，合并丢失约 2/3 更新范数；同一 adapter 合并进 FP8/NVFP4 混合发布版时 93% 更新消失；应用于 Nemotron-3.5 在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上最高提升 8.4 分，BF16 与 NVFP4 双版本均改进。

为什么值得看：直击「训练的是舍入后真正发布的模型」这一数值痛点，让行为修正在量化发布版中真正存活。

item.title: Federated Learning with Uncertainty Quantification on Pseudo Label Exchange
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF

In this work, we investigate federated stochastic operator learning for stochast…

In this work, we investigate federated stochastic operator learning for stochastic partial differential equations (SPDEs), with an emphasis on heterogeneous client data distributions and uncertainty quantification. Federated learning enables clients to collaboratively train models without exchanging their original solution data, but conventional federated averaging can suffer significant performance degradation when client distributions differ, particularly when their input function supports are disjoint. To address these challenges, we propose the Federated Stochastic Operator Network (FedSON), a two-phase framework that combines auxiliary data construction with stochastic operator learning. In the first phase, locally trained deterministic neural operators and their corresponding input functions are exchanged to generate pseudolabeled auxiliary data, enabling the federated model to learn across heterogeneous input distributions without sharing original solution trajectories. In the second phase, a stochastic operator network is trained on top of the frozen deterministic operator to characterize stochastic fluctuations and quantify uncertainty in the predicted solutions. item.title: Evaluation and Restoration of Safety in Reasoning-Tuned LLMs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF

Open-source LLMs that are optimized for reasoning, such as VibeThinker, aim to d…

Open-source LLMs that are optimized for reasoning, such as VibeThinker, aim to democratize AI by bringing high-capability models to users with limited resources. They are broadly available but lack regulation and external guardrails; therefore, in order to integrate them safely into human society, it is critical that they perform in a safe manner. There are popular and intuitive arguments for why improved reasoning should improve safety, but recent evidence suggests that, in fact, the opposite may be true. This paper aims to characterize and mitigate this issue. First, it develops a metric for evaluating LLMs optimized for reasoning, and shows that increasing reasoning across multiple model families increases the unsafe rate in all cases. Second, it proposes a method for restoring safety by combining evolution strategies with a post-training guardrail (ESPG). Compared to alternative methods for safety post-training such as GRPO, ESPG is simple to implement, requires no GPU memory beyond that of inference, and works with remarkably few training samples (e.g.\ 30), yet makes the model significantly safer. The study thus establishes a path towards safe post-training of open-source AI …

First, it develops a metric for evaluating LLMs optimized for reasoning, and shows that increasing reasoning across multiple model families increases the unsafe rate in all cases. Second, it proposes a method for restoring safety by combining evolution strategies with a post-training guardrail (ESPG). Compared to alternative methods for safety post-training such as GRPO, ESPG is simple to implement, requires no GPU memory beyond that of inference, and works with remarkably few training samples (e.g.\ 30), yet makes the model significantly safer. The study thus establishes a path towards safe post-training of open-source AI …

item.title: Estimating GPU Roofline Arithmetic Intensity with Off-the-Shelf LLMs and Compiler Artifacts
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：GPU 开发者做优化常需剖析目标硬件，但访问受限会拖慢优化——现成 LLM 能否不执行负载就估计 Roofline 算术强度（FLOPs/设备内存字节比）？

方法：评估三个模型（deepseek-v4-flash、gemini-3.7-flash、gpt-5.6-sol）在 179 个组合（五类 kernel、四款 NVIDIA/AMD GPU、四种并行运行时、改动代码变体）上的估计能力，比较仅源码、带编译器工件、沙盒 agentic 分析三种查询方式。

关键数字：带编译器工件把算术强度估计进入 1.20 倍容差的比例从 8–14% 提到 26–32%，带宽/计算受限分类正确率 78–92%；FLOP 估计 1.20× 容差内 59–88%，设备内存流量仅 36–40%；agentic 分析对 gpt-5.6-sol 再提升 6.5 个百分点，但中位成本 3.6×、时延 2.5×。

为什么值得看：表明 LLM 估计可在 GPU 访问受限时帮助排定优化优先级，并指出缓存相关设备内存流量是精确预测的主要障碍。

item.title: Eliciting the Recall Capacity of Linear Attention
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF

Linear attention models exhibit a disproportionate deficit relative to softmax attention in associative recall (AR) in language modeling. We investigate this gap through natural language evaluations, synthetic recall tasks, and targeted training interventions. Using a synthetic setting, we quantify the role of state-size in how many items can be recalled from memory and find a similar empirical scaling across the tested linear-attention architectures. Testing this relationship reveals that even a single layer at scale can learn to retrieve thousands of associations across long distances. Yet, standard language model training does not reliably teach a linear model to copy from context, whereas a comparable softmax model learns to do so. Considering this, we strengthen recall supervision during training through in-context sentence repetition and context-sensitive loss reweighting. Both methods improve recall-intensive benchmark performance and narrow the long-distance AR gap to the softmax baseline without changing the architecture, token budget, or number of optimization steps, at a slight cost to general language modeling. These targeted changes to training can thus elicit substant…

item.title: Draft Calibration for Speculative Decoding: Accelerating LLM Serving by Matching Draft and Target Distributions
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：投机解码的加速取决于草稿分布 q 与目标分布 p 的差距——开源草稿模型普遍比目标模型更不自信，能否事后校准草稿分布来缩小差距？

方法：研究投机解码的草稿校准：采用标准温度缩放与逐 token 校准等事后方法，把校准施加到草稿分布上，再分析接受长度与吞吐。

关键数字：对草稿分布做标准温度缩放，在不同任务上接受长度最高提升约 10%，几乎零额外成本；吞吐分析验证了服务效率提升；更一般的校准方法分析显示还有进一步优化空间。

为什么值得看：一个几乎免费的「草稿校准」技巧即可实质提升投机解码效率，对 LLM 服务优化有直接落地价值。

item.title: Discovering Explicit Magnetic Core-Loss Equations via Symbolic Sparse Identification
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF

Compact core loss equations are essential tools in magnetic component design, bu…

Compact core loss equations are essential tools in magnetic component design, but existing approaches trade accuracy against interpretability. Empirical models such as the Steinmetz Equation (SE) yield compact expressions of limited accuracy, while machine learning methods achieve high accuracy as black-box predictors. This paper bridges the gap with a Symbolic Sparse Identification (SSI) framework, which casts core loss modeling as a data-driven symbolic regression problem and recovers unknown equations directly from measured data, without presuming a functional form. First, a comprehensively expanded library of symbolic candidate terms far richer than the SE is constructed. Second, the governing terms are isolated from this library by sparse regression. Third, the coefficients of the retained terms are refined with an AdamW optimizer to maximize accuracy and form an analytical equation. Experiments on Fair-Rite 78, 79, and 95 yield test mean absolute percentage errors of 1.89%, 1.01%, and 1.56%, respectively, with only 10, 10, and 7 active terms. Comparisons with empirical, numerical, and symbolic models quantify the resulting balance of accuracy and compactness. SSI thus provide…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Denotational Results in Compiler Correctness and Comparisons with Operational Approaches
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：证明编译器正确性时选哪种语义风格？指称语义能否用于编译器正确性证明，代价如何？

方法：研究从 FPC（带词法作用域函数与递归类型的语言）到一阶低级中间语言的编译器，含闭包转换；给出图模型与 Scott 域两种指称语义下的闭包转换反射证明（对图模型新提出近似逻辑关系，对 Scott 域改编 Reynolds 逻辑关系）；并用五种语义风格机械化比较一个八趟编译器的正确性证明。

关键数字：五种风格中两种指称、三种操作式；无单一语义使所有编译器趟证明最短；操作式证明规模随源/目标运行差异增长，指称式在「趟正确性即语义间等式」时简洁、需逻辑关系时冗长。

为什么值得看：首次用指称语义证明图灵完备语言的闭包转换语义反射，为编译器正确性证明的语义选型提供了系统比较依据。

item.title: Deletion You Can Check: Auditing LLM Unlearning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.LG)　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF

A common indication that a fine-tuned model has forgotten a deleted record is a …

A common indication that a fine-tuned model has forgotten a deleted record is a membership-inference score near chance (ROC-AUC $\approx 0.5$). This reading is sound only if the comparison population represents how the record should behave after a valid deletion---a counterfactual that is rarely validated. We test this premise in a controlled $2\times2$ study pairing two membership-inference benchmarks, ArxivMIA and BookMIA, with two language models, Llama-3.2-1B and Qwen2.5-1.5B. Exact retraining validates the membership reference: it lies within the prespecified chance band on ArxivMIA but reaches $0.122$ on BookMIA, causing the same metric to reject an empirical deletion reference. A post-hoc BookMIA/Qwen diagnostic replaces benchmark label-0 records with same-pool, never-fine-tuned records and moves the reference from $0.257$ to $0.523$, supporting population mismatch in that cell. Each approximate-unlearning checkpoint is judged jointly on membership removal, deletion-targeted shift beyond non-deletion variation, and utility. On the admitted ArxivMIA/Llama axis, no tested configuration of gradient ascent with retain descent (GA+GD), negative-preference optimization with retain…

item.title: DELTA: Diagnosing Exploration Lineages via Twin-path Alignment - What Can Contrasting Design Paths Reveal About Microarchitectural Behavior?
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF

Architects have two mature instruments for performance work. Top-Down analysis tells them where a design loses its pipeline slots, and design-space exploration (DSE) tells them which configuration scores best. Neither explains why a search stops improving: why a backend-bound design rejects a prefetcher that the bottleneck label recommends, or why a capacity increase that helped in one configuration hurts in the next. This paper argues that the evidence needed to answer such questions is already produced during exploration and then discarded. Every parent-child edge in an exploration tree is a controlled intervention: one knob changes, the rest of the design is held fixed, and a cycle-level simulator measures the outcome. When the same edit helps under one parent and hurts under another, aligning the two parents localizes the interaction that decides its sign. We present DELTA, a simulator-grounded root-cause analysis tool that builds a Design Memory of such interventions during exploration and lets an architect query it afterwards. Each record stores the full parent configuration, the single applied edit, the measured and predicted IPC, a Top-Down breakdown from StallLens, our gem…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: DAiSy: Online Data Selection by Adaptive Utility Estimation for LLM Pretraining
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF

Model-aware online data selection prioritizes the training documents that contribute the most given the model's current state. Existing online selectors rank candidates upon gradient-based data utility scores, which requires the full forward-backward pass of the main model on every candidate document. Scoring each document therefore pays as much as training on it, yet only a small fraction is used for the real model update. We introduce DAiSy, a lightweight linear auxiliary model that learns to predict data utility scores from frozen document embeddings, which eliminates the computation overhead and infrastructure burdens. The linear estimator is updated alongside the main language model, fitting to the exact gradient-based utility scores obtained from the backward pass of regular training steps. Consequently, scoring a candidate requires only a linear transformation, bypassing the costly gradient-alignment computation. We demonstrate its effectiveness and efficiency for LLM pretraining in English and multilingual scenarios, with various steering target designs. The improvements from DAiSy can consistently survive the instruction-tuning phase.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Cross-Layer Characterization and AI-Assisted Diagnosis of C-to-Rust Performance
item.description:
发表方：arXiv (cs.PF)　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题： C 迁移到 Rust 常被认为性能等价，但运行时安全检查、编译器优化与硬件微架构的相互作用使性能诊断变得复杂，迁移到底付出多少性能代价？

方法： 对 12 个 benchmark 的 C/Rust 实现做跨层系统刻画；提出 AI 辅助性能调试器 FerroScope（集成源码分析、编译优化报告、指令轨迹与硬件计数器）；据此开发 LLVM pass，通过带守卫的循环版本化提升冗余边界检查。

关键数字： 8/12 个 benchmark 中至少一个 Rust 实现达到 C 的 10% 以内或更优；Selection Sort 开销从 2.95x 降到 1.00x，Merge Sort 从 1.43x 降到 0.91x（相对 C）。

为什么值得看： 证明"安全检查不一定主导性能开销"，且可在保持 Rust panic 语义的前提下实现无损迁移优化。

item.title: Contrastive Proxy Forests: Completeness-Preserving Proxy Learning from Multimodal Records
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF

Proximal causal inference removes unmeasured confounding using two proxies of the confounder, an outcome-side W and a treatment-side Z. The proxies must satisfy exclusion restrictions and be complete, meaning that they reflect every aspect of the confounder. In practice, they are a few variables hand-picked from a structured table, even though clinical notes and physiological waveforms carry rich information about the confounder. Such records are too high-dimensional for a proximal estimator, and generic compression such as PCA may keep modality-specific variation (style) instead of the confounder, destroying completeness. Our key observation is that, under the proximal condition, the confounder is the only link between a treatment-side and an outcome-side modality beyond the covariates. Learning what they share therefore captures the confounder and filters out modality-specific style. Contrastive Proxy Forests (CPF) learns both proxies by contrasting the two modalities, given the covariates, on a separate unlabeled sample, and passes them to a proximal causal forest. This contrastive objective has an exact closed-form solution, ridge canonical correlation analysis. We prove that C…

item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：不给工具、不给数据、也不让跑推理，前沿 LLM 仅凭权重文本能否修复被量化损坏的网络？

方法：把 20k 参数 CIFAR-10 CNN 的完整权重以文本形式给四个 Claude 系列 LLM，要求产出 4-bit 网络；设计四种输入与任务描述不同的评估协议（给浮点+量化网络 vs 只给浮点网络自选优化策略），分析其回答。

关键数字：标准 RTN 量化到 4-bit 把测试准确率从 81.4% 打到 60.4%；Opus 5.5 逐层回答把 4-bit 网络准确率恢复到 77.95%（距浮点 3.5 pp、距 AdaRound 2.8 pp）；只给浮点网络时模型能指出误差抵消修正但退回 RTN，仍把 Fable 5.2 的量化网络抬到 70.0%。

为什么值得看：展示了前沿 LLM 具备免工具、免数据的「权重空间编程」修复能力，为训练后量化的自动化提供了全新思路。

item.title: CPU-Eval: Evaluating Large Language Models for CPU Hardware Code Generation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：VerilogEval 上 HDL 生成通过率已超 90%，缺乏区分度——如何为 LLM 生成硬件代码提供一个更有挑战、贴近实际开发任务的基准？

方法：构建 CPU-Eval，从六个 CPU 设计（含已流片家族，覆盖嵌入式小核到可跑 Linux 的无序核，SystemVerilog/Chisel/SpinalHDL 三种语言）提炼 339 个 HDL 生成问题，让 LLM 执行真实的 CPU 开发任务。

关键数字：七个 SOTA LLM 在 CPU-Eval 上平均 pass@1 比 VerilogEval v2 Spec-to-RTL 低 45.14 个百分点；子模块源码行数越多 pass@1 越低；较少使用的 HDL 上 pass@1 更低。

为什么值得看：暴露了 VerilogEval 高通过率掩盖的模型能力差距，并提示细粒度模块化设计与按目标 HDL 验证模型熟练度的工程策略。

item.title: Breaking Routing And Inter-device Dependencies in Mixture-of-Experts
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：MoE 模型规模增大后专家并行（EP）的 token 分发与合并成为推理瓶颈，而标准 MoE 架构的顺序依赖限制了通信与计算重叠——如何打破这些依赖？

方法：提出 BRAID-MoE：用阶梯式残差连接把每个专家的合并推迟到下一个块，用提前路由（early routing）在合并前残差上计算下一路由决策，从而在专用通信流上背靠背执行前一次合并与下一次分发，与注意力计算重叠。

关键数字：Qwen3 形态 0.4B-A0.1B 与 2.5B-A0.5B 上匹配顺序训练，验证损失仅增 1% 与 0.5%；转换的 Qwen3-30B-A3B 预填充加速最高 1.29×、解码 1.37×，跨多样负载与 EP 配置至少 1.12×；现有 checkpoint 可小幅续训适配。

为什么值得看：提前路由 + 阶梯残差的设计在几乎不损质量的前提下显著改善 MoE 推理的通信-计算重叠，且能迁移现有 checkpoint。

item.title: Branch and Consolidate: A Unified Recipe for Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF

Specialists post-trained from a shared checkpoint acquire complementary capabilities, and multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) can consolidate them into a single model. However, we find that existing consolidation methods, from weight merging to MOPD, fall short when specialists diverge substantially from the shared checkpoint, whereas prior studies mostly examine specialists that remain close to it. We present a unified recipe for multimodal MOPD that consolidates such specialists back into the single student they branched from. The recipe specifies initialization, data selection, balanced supervision across teachers, and preservation of existing capabilities for consolidation, together with a targeted refinement stage for capabilities that still lag behind their specialists. In an industrial setting with six specialists, the student closely approaches each specialist in its own domain and surpasses the perception specialist. It recovers 97.0% of their average gain, compared with 79.8% for IM-MOPD. In the fully open five-domain setting with Qwen3-4B, our method recovers 95.7% of the specialists' average gain after consolidation and 97.5% after refinement, compared with 94.1…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Blockchain-IoT Convergence for Spatiotemporal Data Systems: Challenges, Solutions, and Research Gaps
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF

Blockchain in conjunction with the Internet of Things (IoT) is changing the management of spatiotemporal data in a way that has never been possible before now. In the process of gathering geospatial and time-stamped data from a large network of IoT devices, data authenticity, accuracy, and timely processing are major issues. Spatiotemporal indexing in a blockchain environment is necessary for ensure quick data retrieval; supporting real time data processing requirement. Blockchain with its decentralized consensus mechanism is a possible solution for preventing data fabrication, unauthorized access, and single point of failure in IoT based spatiotemporal applications. This paper aims to describe how Blockchain and IoT indexing can be combined to enhance the spatiotemporal data management (specifically indexing and querying of data). Literature solutions will be reviewed and compared to highlight challenges and insights for future blockchain-integrated IoT in resilient spatiotemporal data ecosystems.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Beyond Hard Tokens: Predictive Memory for Multimodal Protein Generation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF

Multimodal protein language models unify sequence and discrete structural tokens via iterative masked decoding, offering a promising paradigm for joint protein design. However, standard decoders rely on a memoryless mask reset at each iteration: only a sparse subset of newly committed hard tokens is carried forward, while all remaining unresolved sites are reset to an identical [MASK] embedding. In open-ended co-generation where neither modality provides a fixed external anchor, this stateless transition limits single-step refinement depth and deprives both tracks of stable cross-step soft anchors, leading to slow convergence or degenerative repetitive collapse. Observing that uncommitted predictions evolve with pronounced temporal coherence rather than erratic noise, we introduce Predictive Memory (PredMem), a training-free self-conditioning recurrence that carries these soft beliefs across steps. At each step, PredMem summarizes raw logits into a probability-weighted Top-$k$ expectation embedding at every residue and affinely interpolates it into eligible masked inputs on the next step at zero extra denoiser cost. Across DPLM-2, DPLM-2.1, and ESM3, PredMem raises unconditional se…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Beyond Autoregression: Diffusion Language Model is All Analog In-Memory Computing Need
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：模拟存内计算（AIMC）的硬件非理想性会扰动矩阵向量乘并降低生成质量，自回归模型尤其脆弱——扩散语言模型能否作为更鲁棒的替代范式？

方法：研究迭代精化掩码序列的扩散语言模型（DLM）在持续权重扰动下的表现；用真实硅片测量校准的噪声模型做大规模仿真，并在 16 芯片 28nm eFlash AIMC 集群上做混合板载测量。

关键数字：规模匹配的模型对与开放 checkpoint 上，DLM 比自回归对应模型退化更平缓；16 芯片集群上 DLM 可容忍 1.4–3× 更大的权重噪声；更大的去噪步预算进一步缩小干净-噪声差距。

为什么值得看：首次系统论证扩散生成范式对噪声鲁棒 AIMC 推理的价值，为模拟存算硬件上的语言模型推理提供了新路线。

item.title: Analysis of Federated Graph Neural Networks for Predicting Nuclear Core Properties
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF

Federated learning has grown in popularity owing to the increasing data privacy and safety concerns. It allows multiple parties to collaboratively train a model without exchanging their raw data. As an example of highly sensitive infrastructure of national importance, nuclear reactors benefit from this approach, where---while pooling multiple large datasets from different institutions could improve machine learning solutions---the confidentiality of the datasets is paramount. In this paper, we demonstrate that a graph neural network (GNN) outperforms the convolutional neural network (CNN) baseline in a federated setting for a use case concerning nuclear reactor core optimization. The GNN architecture is better suited for the nuclear reactor geometry as, unlike the CNN, it does not require padding the cylindrical core and does not assume translation invariance. The key finding of this work is that input representation is more important than model size and complexity. More sophisticated federated algorithms were employed, but the improvements derived were of lower magnitude. Experimenting with training corpus volume led to the discovery that greater fuel inventory variance is more be…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: AgentDRC: Multi-Agent Algorithms for Spatially-Aware Automated DRC Correction
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF

Design Rule Checking (DRC) error fixing remains a time-consuming bottleneck in physical design, often requiring manual intervention despite advanced EDA optimizations. Existing LLM-agent approaches fall short due to redundant contextual shapes, limited spatial reasoning over raw coordinates, and inefficient flat layout representations. We propose AgentDRC, which formulates iterative DRC correction as a multi-agent algorithm and introduces a spatial-aware verification and correction algorithm that reconstructs structured spatial relations among critical shapes and validates fixes through geometric and semantic constraint checking. The system coordinates four specialized agents to perceive multi-level, multi-modal geometric features, filter irrelevant shapes, and iteratively correct violations. Experiments show that AgentDRC achieves up to 30.4% pass@1 and 55.7% pass@5 on challenging violations, with 13.8% pass@5 improvement over the best baseline. We will open-source all code and benchmark tasks upon acceptance.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: AVQ-Attention-2: Adaptive Vector-Quantized Attention with Exact Local Blocks and Linear-Cost Training
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：向量量化注意力把注意力从 O(N²) 降到 O(NM)，自适应形式 AVQ 还能把码本分辨率集中到查询注意力真正落的地方——如何进一步改进？

方法：提出 AVQ-Attention-2，把自适应向量量化注意力与精确局部注意力合并，并改为关注每个簇 key 的均值而非码字；训练成本同样降到 O(NM)。

关键数字：质量在可比成本下一致更好；训练从 O(N²) 降到 O(NM)；近似精度足以让该层免微调直接替换进预训练 transformer；多种序列长度下不仅匹敌其他近似注意力，还能与精确稠密注意力竞争，运行快于 FlashAttention 且质量几乎无损。

为什么值得看：把「码字均值 + 精确局部块」的组合做成了可即插即用的层，兼顾训练成本与质量，对长序列 transformer 有实用价值。

item.title: A Unified Control Framework for Gradient Inversion Defense in Federated Learning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF

Gradient perturbations are widely recognized as an effective defense against gradient inversion attacks in federated learning, but they are equally known to impair optimization, creating a persistent tension between privacy and utility. In this paper, we show that existing gradient perturbation defenses, despite their different formulations, can be unified under a controlled dynamics framework, providing a cohesive understanding of their optimization behavior and enabling the derivation of universal convergence and safety conditions without relying on case-specific analyses. Leveraging this observation, we propose ``Near Orthogonal Gradient Projection (NODE)'', which injects perturbations only along directions orthogonal to the original gradient so that the defended gradient maintains a fixed cosine similarity with the true gradient. By preserving the first-order descent direction, NODE substantially reduces the optimization cost of strong perturbations while maintaining effective protection against gradient inversion attacks. item.title: A Bias in Disguise: Tiny Gradient Edits Stop a Small Language Model's Thinking Loops and Complement a Frontier Model's Weight Edit
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-24　分类：论文PDF

Qwen3.5-0.8B rarely finishes reasoning in thinking mode: at a 4,096-token budget only 1 or 2 of 500 MATH-500 answers close their think block (two seeds), and accuracy is 15.4%. A recent demonstration had GPT-6 Astra edit 131,072 of the model's weights without gradients and reported MATH-500 rising from 7.9% to 48.1% at a 32,768-token budget. We provide the missing gradient baseline, then combine the two edits. Fine-tuning only the 140 to 139,750 weights with the largest gradient, on the model's own correct answers to MATH training problems, raises thinking-mode MATH-500 at 4k tokens to 39.0-45.5% after 2-9 minutes of training on one GPU; 50 training examples suffice, and 1,398 random positions give only 16.3%. The gradient concentrates the edit on the most nearly constant channel of each of the first three layers. Because the model has no bias terms, an edit confined to those channels acts as a constant vector added to the residual stream: adding three fixed vectors to the unedited model matches the accuracy of such an edit. Under the Astra protocol (32k tokens, presence penalty 1.5), the Astra edit scores 52.1% (finished and correct) in our reproduction and our full-strength edits…

item.title: Yggdrasil: Tree-Routed Recurrent Experts for State Tracking and Fast CPU Inference
item.description:
发表方：arXiv　发布：2026-11-23　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：Mamba、线性注意力、DeltaNet 等可并行训练循环提供常数开销流式推理，但难跟踪离散状态，且每步读全部参数，模型容量直接绑定 CPU 延迟。

方法：Yggdrasil 树路由循环专家：每层在大规模树路由专家库中查转移，用当前 token 与下层状态寻址；证明跨层上下文必要（单 token 索引、有限可达状态的非扩张转移层无法做条件重置）；每步走一条树路径、每层读单个专家，活跃权重仅几百 KB 留在 CPU L2，全库驻留 RAM。

关键数字：评估的并行可训练模型中唯一解全部 5 个状态跟踪任务；匹配活跃参数下 enwik8 最低 1.540 bpb、人类基因组 hg38 1.567 bpb；单 CPU 核 6.7μs/5.8μs 步进，比最快流式基线快 3.0x/3.3x；batch 1024 GPU 吞吐最高；Genomic Benchmarks 匹配活跃参数下最强因果模型（平均准确率 86.0%）。

为什么值得看：容量与每步计算解耦 + 离散状态跟踪，CPU 流式推理新范式。

Unreliable failure detectors (UFDs) are a fundamental abstraction for dependability and fault tolerance in distributed systems, supporting core distributed algorithms, such as consensus. Yet selecting a suitable detector remains difficult because existing implementations are evaluated under different environments, workloads, parameterizations, and quality-of-service (QoS) requirements. We address this problem by systematizing 14 $\Diamond \mathcal{P}$ and closely related $\Diamond \mathcal{P}$-style UFDs, implementing 13 of them, and providing a reusable benchmark for their empirical comparison. Our methodology evaluates detectors through common QoS metrics, such as detection time, mistake rate, and query accuracy, and combines same-input replay of network traces with live deployment for detectors whose active probing or cooperative behavior requires online execution.
